name: Wings for Life 2026 Gdańsk Południe
description: Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race that takes place simultaneously worldwide. Instead of a traditional finish line, participants race against a virtual Catcher Car, which starts 30 minutes after the runners and gradually increases its speed until it catches the last participant. In Gdańsk Południe, the race will be held on May 10, 2026, starting at 13:00 near the finish area at Parkrun Gdańsk-Poludnie. The route is a loop approximately 3 km long on a paved surface, with a minimal incline on the connector. All proceeds from the entry fees support spinal cord research.
course_highlights: Walking and running route approximately 3 km long on a loop
Paved surface, uneven in some areas near a large reservoir
Minimal incline on the connector towards the smaller reservoir
additional: The race is accessible to runners and wheelchair participants. The Catcher Car starts 30 minutes after the runners, at a speed of 14 km/h, and gradually accelerates. 100% of the entry fees are allocated to spinal cord research. Participants use the Wings for Life World Run app to track the race and results. The race begins at 13:00, with participants registering and tracking progress via the app. The event is open to runners and wheelchair users.

name: Wings for Life World Run 2026 Poznań
description: Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race where all participants start simultaneously worldwide, running to escape from the Catch Car. The race has no traditional finish line — participants run as long as they can before being caught by the car. All proceeds from registration fees are donated to research on spinal cord injury treatment, making this race not only a sporting challenge but also a charitable event. You can participate locally or via the app, allowing you to run from anywhere in the world.
course_highlights: Simultaneous start worldwide
No traditional finish line — chased by the Catch Car
Race for runners, wheelchair users, and beginners
additional: Participants can join the race locally or through the Wings for Life World Run app, which tracks time and distance. 100% of registration fees support spinal cord research. Marketing tools and promotional materials are available for local race organizers with the app. Participation supports research on spinal cord injury treatment; the event includes merchandise sales and the option to join remotely, with all proceeds dedicated to scientific causes.

The organizers ensure professional organization of the event on a nationwide scale, while maintaining a friendly and family atmosphere. The event is part of a running series promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity.
course_highlights: Races on 5 km and 10 km distances
The atmosphere of Toruń running
Spring edition of the Toruń Legends Trilogy
additional: The race is organized by the Association "Run To Run", which promotes a healthy lifestyle and sports. The event has a nationwide character but maintains a friendly and family atmosphere. Participants can expect a unique medal and the opportunity to take part in a satisfaction survey after the race. 5 km and 10 km races, spring edition, Toruń Legends Trilogy series.

name: Sierakowicka Piętnastka
description: Sierakowicka Piętnastka is an annual race organized in Sierakowice, part of the Northern Poland Running Festival. The event takes place at the sports stadium at 7 Kubuś Puchatek Street and attracts runners of all ages, offering both the main 15 km race and numerous children's and youth races. The competition features electronic timing, rich event organization, and prizes for the best competitors. Participants can expect professional organization, including medical and police security, as well as amenities such as deposit, showers, and a café.
course_highlights: Main race route of 15 km
Start and finish at the sports stadium in Sierakowice
Electronic timing and classification in 14 categories
additional: The race office is open from 10:00 at the Orlik near the Primary School, where race numbers and chips are issued. Free showers, deposit, café, and toilets are available. Children's and youth races start at 11:30, with a preschooler 100 m race at 12:40 (free of charge). A recreational walk-run of 1200 m begins at 13:05 for those not participating in the main races. Prize draws for children's and main race participants. Official parking is available at 7 Kubuś Puchatek Street. Medical and police security are provided. The event also includes preparatory training sessions, and online registration will start in December 2025. The race takes place at the sports stadium in Sierakowice, ul. Kubuś Puchatek 7.

name: V Bieg Ratownika
description: The 5th Rescue Runner Race is a jubilee event marking the fifth edition of a competition that combines sports rivalry with educational and integrational missions. Participants can compete on professionally prepared routes of 5 km and 10 km, as well as in recreational formats, including Nordic walking and a 5 km dog run. For the youngest, a safe and joyful competition on a 200 m distance is organized. After the race, a family-educational picnic with numerous attractions and the jubilee edition takes place. The event is held in Katowice at 180 French Street and promotes the idea of first aid and responsibility for others.
course_highlights: Professionally prepared routes of 5 km and 10 km
Participation options in Nordic walking and a 5 km dog run
Safe competition for children on a 200 m distance
additional: After the race, a family-educational picnic with numerous attractions and the jubilee of the 5th edition will take place. The number of participants is limited to 1060. There is an option to start with a dog on the 5 km route. Family atmosphere and support from spectators. Promotion of first aid and responsibility for others. The event also includes recreational options, and participants can enjoy an educational picnic after the race.

name: VII Bieg im. Rektora Stanisława Komornic...
description: The 7th Rector Stanisław Komornicza Run is a street race covering a distance of 10 km, taking place in Tarnów. This sporting event is aimed at runners of various skill levels, offering preparation opportunities through dedicated training plans. The race is street-based and held in the picturesque city of Tarnów, providing participants with an attractive route and sporting excitement.
course_highlights: Street route of 10 km
Picturesque areas of Tarnów
Suitable for runners of different skill levels
additional: Training plans available from 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to the runner's VDOT level with instructions and expert support. No detailed information about registration fees, and registration has not been described in detail.

name: XII Bieg Kwitnących Ogrodów
organizer: Klub Biegacza Im. P. Sękowskiego w Płońsku
description: The XII Blooming Gardens Run is an annual running event held in Kucharach Królewskich. The competition includes various distances suitable for different age groups, including races for preschoolers, school children, the main 10 km run, a 3 km accompanying run, and a 6 km Nordic Walking march. The start and finish are located at the forester's lodge, and participants can enjoy festive decorations and a prize draw after the event. The participant limit is 300 people, ensuring an intimate atmosphere.
course_highlights: Main run of 10 km
Accompanying run of 3 km
Nordic Walking march of 6 km
additional: Participant limit is 300 people. Registration and chip distribution take place from 9:30 to 10:15. After the races, around 1:00 PM, a ceremonial closing with decorations and a prize draw will be held on the main stage. Registration opens on March 19, 2026. The event includes various age categories and levels of difficulty.

name: XXIII Bieg Skawiński XIV Bieg Skawiński na Rolkach
description: The 23rd Skawiński Run is an annual sporting event with over 20 years of tradition, held in Skawina. The event combines professional competition with a family atmosphere and promotes an active lifestyle. The program includes races for children and youth, the 9th Memorial of Tomasz Staszczak, the 17th Polish Championships for Energy Workers, the 4th Skawiński Nordic Walking 10 km race, and the 14th Skawiński Inline Skating Race over 9 km. The race route runs on a renovated, even surface, ensuring comfort and safety for participants.
course_highlights: Race route towards Radziszów on a renovated, even surface
Races for children and youth in the Skawińskie Błonia
Main competitions start on Żwirki i Wigury Street in Skawina
additional: The event features rich start packages and attractive prizes for the best competitors. Among participants, a draw for special prizes, including televisions, takes place regardless of the place achieved. The sporting excitement begins early in the morning with races for children and youth. The event includes running, roller skating, Nordic Walking competitions, attractions for children, prizes, and surprise draws. The start and finish are located in Skawina, and the route runs through renovated, comfortable surfaces, ensuring safety and the possibility of setting personal records.

name: Backyard Ultra Jabłonna
location: Jabłonna, Legionowo County, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Backyard Ultra Jabłonna is a unique ultra-format race that originated in the USA. Participants start every hour and must complete a loop of 6.706 km. After finishing the loop, they have rest time until the next full hour, and the competition continues until only one participant remains who completes the last loop within the time limit. It is an endurance race where not only speed but also strategy and perseverance matter.
course_highlights: Loop of 6.706 km (4.167 miles)
Start every full hour
Unique format - race lasts until a single winner is determined
additional: No podium - only a throne for the winner. Adult event. The time limit to complete each loop is 1 hour. Regulations and map available for download on the website. The event features the Backyard Ultra format, with participant limits and online registration. The series also includes winter editions and special editions with prizes such as the Silver Ticket to the World Championships.

name: Cytadela by Night # 115 - Wartostrada
location: Cytadela, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Cytadela by Night is a series of free timed runs organized in Poznań on distances of 5 km and 10 km. The races take place in the picturesque surroundings of the Citadel, offering participants a unique nocturnal racing atmosphere. The event attracts runners of various age groups and skill levels, promoting physical activity and local community integration.
course_highlights: The route runs through the Citadel area in Poznań
Distances of 5 km and 10 km with timing measurement
Nighttime race atmosphere
additional: The races are free of charge, organized regularly, with timing measurement. The event is supported by Kiprun Poznań Runners. The event is free, takes place at night, attracts participants from different age groups and skill levels, promoting physical activity and community integration.

name: XIII Bieg 5 Mil
organizer: Gdyński Dywizjon Okrętów Bojowych, Gdyńskie Centrum Sportu, Stowarzyszenie Oficerów Marynarki Wojennej
description: The XIII 5 MILE Run is a race over a distance of 5 nautical miles (9260 meters), organized in Gdynia by the Gdynia Combat Ships Squadron and the Navy Officers' Association in cooperation with the Gdynia Sports Center. The route consists of two loops of 4630 meters each and runs along the quay, with the start and finish located in front of the ORP "Gen. K. Pułaski" ship. The race is open to active professional soldiers, civilian military employees, and civilian competitors after prior verification. The event is held in a friendly atmosphere, promoting physical activity and the sporting spirit.
course_highlights: Distance of 5 nautical miles (9260 m) - two loops of 4630 m
Start and finish in front of the ORP "Gen. K. Pułaski" ship
Seaside route in Gdynia, without PZLA certification
additional: Payments are processed via Przelewy24. Participants must be verified; foreigners can participate after prior arrangement with the organizer. The participant limit is 500 people, online registration, recovery meal, no PZLA certification.

name: Ultra-Trail® Malopolska
location: Gorce and Beskid mountains, Małopolska, Poland
description: Ultra-Trail® Małopolska is a festival of challenging mountain running held in the Małopolska region, in the Gorce and Beskid Mountains. The event offers a variety of distances from 16 to 240 km, which lead through scenic and demanding mountain trails. Organized by the 4 Alternatives Foundation, it attracts runners who appreciate challenges and the beauty of mountain nature. Ultra-Trail® Małopolska is an excellent opportunity to test your strength on routes of varying difficulty and experience the unique atmosphere of ultra running.
course_highlights: Routes lead through the Gorce and Beskid Mountains
Distances from 16 km to 240 km, including very demanding ultramarathons
Scenic and technical mountain trails
additional: The organizer is the 4 Alternatives Foundation based in Kraków. The event also features other running competitions, including Szczebel CUP and Winter Trail Małopolska. There is a training camp for Ultra-Trail® Małopolska with professional instructors and coordinator Paweł Derlatka. Contact details for the organizer and camp coordinator are available at fundacja@utm.run and by phone. Information about registration, route details, and event updates can be found on the organizer's website. The event also includes a winter edition, Winter Trail Małopolska, scheduled for December 2025.

name: Biegi Śnieżnickie
location: Międzygórze, Kłodzko County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Snow Mountain Runs are legendary mountain races held in the picturesque Międzygórze, in the heart of the Śnieżnik Massif. The routes feature demanding ascents and technical descents, leading through beautiful forest paths and gravel roads, as well as to the very summit of Śnieżnik. This event, with a rich tradition dating back to the 1990s, attracts both amateurs and elite runners from across Europe. Participants can choose between the classic alpine race of 9.6 km and the Snow Mountain Half Marathon of approximately 21 km, which encircles the Crown of Śnieżnik.
course_highlights: Alpine race 9.6 km with over 800 m elevation gain on a short distance
Half Marathon 21 km with fast descents, demanding ascents, and singletracks
Scenic routes through forests and ridges of the Śnieżnik Massif with a legendary finish at the summit
additional: The alpine race (9.7 km) starts at 10:30 from the promenade by the Wilczki Waterfall, with the finish at the Śnieżnik summit. The Snow Mountain Half Marathon (21 km) starts at 10:30 from Senatoryjna Street. The race office and participant verification take place at OW Słoneczna, Sanatoryjna 2. After the race, there is a sports festival and prize draw. Time measurement at the finish until 13:00. Mountain routes, races of 9.6 km, half marathon, marathon, scheduled for May 2026, with a history and tradition of mountain running.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – edycja wiosenna 2026
location: Leśny Ogród Botaniczny Marszewo, Gdynia, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia - spring edition 2026 is a cross-country run organized in the picturesque Marszewo Botanical Forest Garden in Gdynia. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka race series, which has been promoting running and the beauty of natural routes in Poland since 2014. The race attracts running enthusiasts who value contact with nature and the aesthetic environment. It is an excellent opportunity to spend active time outdoors amidst greenery and a unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in the Marszewo Botanical Forest Garden
Picturesque natural surroundings and aesthetic qualities
Spring run as part of the Botaniczna Piątka series
additional: The race takes place from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM. Organizers are a group of running enthusiasts emphasizing cross-country races and the aesthetics of the location. The event is part of a series of races held in various Polish cities during the spring season. It is aimed at runners of different skill levels, with the option to participate in the 5 km run. The race promotes outdoor activity and popularizes running within the local community.

name: I Górski Pólmaraton Szczytniański
location: Szczytna, Kłodzko County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Górski Półmaraton Szczytniański is a unique running event held in the picturesque Szczytna, featuring a 21.1 km route with numerous mountain ascents. The race offers beautiful views of the charming town of the Kłodzko Land and a contact with nature, providing unforgettable experiences for every participant. The event also includes a 10 km Nordic Walking march, which is an excellent option for those who value active recreation without time pressure. The Szczytna Biega Association, organizer of the event, promotes a healthy lifestyle and integrates the local running community.
course_highlights: Route of the half marathon 21.1 km with many mountain ascents
Picturesque views and contact with nature in the charming Kłodzko Land region
Nordic Walking 10 km without time measurement, with prizes and a shared finish line with runners
additional: 10% discount for teams of 5 or more people. Nordic Walking without time measurement, prizes at the finish line, shared finish line with half marathon participants. The Nordic Walking route leads through the most beautiful corners of the Kłodzko Land with forest paths and Sudeck climate. Mountain running, training preparations and plans available online, an event aimed at trail running enthusiasts and mountain challenges.

name: Kiełczowska Dycha i Piątka
location: Kiełczów, Wrocław, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Kiełczowska Dycha and Five-Kilometer Run is a unique running event scheduled for May 23, 2026, in Kiełczów. It is a full Sports Day designed for both professionals and amateurs, as well as entire families. The run combines athletic competition with community integration, offering positive energy and the opportunity to improve running results. The event is part of the Running Grand Prix of the Copper Basin and promotes physical activity at various levels of proficiency.
course_highlights: Scenic and runner-friendly route in Kiełczów
Two distance options: 10 km and 5 km
Family event with an atmosphere of integration and sporting competition
additional: Registration is conducted through an external system at fitstrefa-kielczow.cms.efitness.com.pl. The event is part of the Running Grand Prix of the Copper Basin. Timing is provided by Feniks - Timing, ensuring professional electronic timing services. Street race, online registration available, the event promotes sport and community integration.

name: Maraton Zagłębiowski
location: ArcelorMittal Park – ZPS Sosnowiec, Sosnowiec, Śląskie, Poland
organizer: Centrum Sportu i Rekreacji w Dąbrowie Górniczej
description: The Zagłębiowski Marathon is a prestigious marathon held at ArcelorMittal Park - ZPS Sosnowiec. The route has an official certification from the Polish Athletic Association (PZLA), which guarantees a precisely measured distance and reliable results. This event is for runners of various skill levels, combining athletic competition with the satisfaction of overcoming personal challenges. The organizers ensure professional organization and extensive support for participants.
course_highlights: Route with official PZLA certification
Race held at ArcelorMittal Park - ZPS Sosnowiec
Professionally prepared and accurately measured route
additional: Registration is conducted through the Datasport Registration Portal. Participants can choose to run in the individual marathon or in a two-person relay, where each participant completes a half marathon. The marathon route is certified, allowing for result comparisons with other races. The event is part of the Zagłębiowska Triada, a series of three races in the region. The event includes relay options, a 6-hour time limit, and attractions on the route, including the halfway point at Pogoria 3 and a fan zone.

name: Pancerna Piątka
organizer: Zarząd Wojewódzki NSZZ Policjantów województwa podkarpackiego
description: Pancerna Piątka is the Podkarpackie Police Championships in street running over a distance of 5 km, held in Żurawica. The event is under the Honorary Patronage of the Provincial Police Commander in Rzeszów. Over 400 participants take part in the competition, and the route runs through the roads of Żurawica. The organizer is the Provincial Board of the NSZZ Policemen of the Podkarpackie Voivodeship.
course_highlights: Street run over a distance of 5 km
The route runs through the roads of Żurawica
Event under the Honorary Patronage of the Provincial Police Commander in Rzeszów
additional: Over 400 participants compete in the event. The organizer is the Provincial Board of the NSZZ Policemen of the Podkarpackie Voivodeship. The run takes place on May 23, 2026, with electronic timing, and is part of local events promoting sport and physical activity.

name: Ultramaraton Jaga-Kora
description: The Jaga-Kora Ultramarathon is a mountain ultra race held in the picturesque region of the Low Beskids, on routes of varying difficulty. The event references the historic Courier Route "Jaga-Kora" from World War II, giving the race a unique character and historical significance. Participants can choose from five distances, ranging from 19 km to 101 km, passing through the areas of Jaśliska and Rymanów-Zdrój. The race is certified by ITRA and UTMB, highlighting its prestige in the mountain running community.
course_highlights: The route is based on the historic Courier Route "Jaga-Kora" from World War II
Five distances of varying difficulty: 101 km, 68 km, 42 km, 33 km, and 19 km
Runs through scenic areas of the Low Beskids, including Jaśliska and Rymanów-Zdrój
additional: Starts take place at night and in the morning on May 23, 2026, with different times for each distance. The race office is open on May 22 from 17:00 to 22:00 and on May 23 from 5:00 to 7:30. Bus transportation is organized to the start points for the 100 km, 33 km, and 19 km distances. The routes have specified closing times, and winners' ceremonies are held on the amphitheater stage near the Altana by the Black Stream. No prizes will be shipped to those absent from the awards ceremony. Registration opens on December 1, 2025. Detailed routes and schedules are available on the organizer's website. The event features refreshment points, awards, live tracking, and online results.

name: Bieg Ulicą Piotrkowską Rossman Run
description: The Piotrkowska Street Run Rossmann Run is one of the most important running events in Poland, taking place in the city center of Łódź on Piotrkowska Street. Established in 2003, the race attracts both amateurs and top athletes from the country. The course runs through the representative avenue of the city, and the event features a rich program of attractions, including a food zone and a free recovery meal. There is a Mini Run for children and people with disabilities on shorter distances.
course_highlights: The race course runs along Piotrkowska Street in Łódź
Start and finish at al. Scheiblerów, close to al. Poznańskich
Evening start at 19:00 with start zones divided according to declared times
additional: The race office is open from Wednesday to Saturday at Łódź Fabryczna Station. Deposits and changing rooms are available at the station. Showers are available at Well Fitness club upon presentation of the start number. Participants have free travel on Łódzka Kolej Aglomeracyjna on race day. After the race, the organizer provides a free recovery meal - soup. Each participant can use a one-hour access to the swimming and sauna zone at Aquapark Fala from May 20 to 25, 2026. It is forbidden for accompanying persons to move on the route by bicycles, scooters, and other vehicles. Traffic disruptions and public transport delays are expected during the race, which starts at 19:00, with disruptions from 18:00 to 21:30.

name: 10 Family Run
description: The 10th KSOS Family Run is a special celebration of family running events held at Kraków Błonia. The event combines generations, promotes physical activity and family integration, offering various races for children, parents, and an open race for everyone. The event features games, activities for children, a simultaneous chess game, and artistic performances, creating a joyful and sporty atmosphere for the whole family. It is an excellent opportunity to stay fit, meet in a relaxed environment, and enjoy outdoor activity together.
course_highlights: All races take place on the grassy area of Kraków Błonia
Open 5 km race with a time limit of 46 minutes
Children's races on distances from 200 m to 2100 m adapted to age
additional: Opportunity to participate in more than one race. Parental or guardian declaration required for children. Participant limit: 90 for the Open Race, 190 in total for the Mom and Dad Race, 455 in total for Children's Races. Race kit with T-shirt guaranteed only with prior registration and payment. Race office open on 22.05.2026 (16:00 - 20:00) and 23.05.2026 (8:30 - 11:30). In the 'Wilczki' race (children born in 2020 and later), parental supervision on the route is allowed. All races take place on the lawns of Kraków Błonia; the event is aimed at the local community, schools, and families; detailed route information available one week before the event.

name: 23. Półmaraton Hajnowski
price_range: 180.00 PLN (standard), 90.00 PLN (zniżki dla mieszkańców powiatu Hajnowskiego i seniorów)
description: The 23rd Hajnówka Half Marathon is a unique and one-of-a-kind race held in the picturesque area of Białowieża, near Hajnówka. The half marathon route runs through charming areas of the Hajnówka Municipal Park, offering participants contact with nature and beautiful views. The event is very popular and is organized by the Sports and Recreation Center in Hajnówka, which ensures the comfort and safety of runners. The race office is open the day before the race and on the race day, and participants can count on race packets and a coffee buffet.
course_highlights: Route runs through Hajnówka Municipal Park
Picturesque areas of Białowieża and surroundings
Contact with nature and beautiful views
additional: The race office is open on May 22 from 15:00 to 21:00 at the Amphitheater of the Hajnówka Municipal Park and on May 23 from 8:00 to 9:30. A valid ID is required to collect the race packet. It is not possible to run under another participant's name. No registrations on race day. Participants have access to a free coffee buffet. The route is asphalt, starting in Białowieża, finishing in Hajnówka, race office at the amphitheater, massages and showers available after the race.

name: Bieg Lwa
location: Tarnów Podgórny, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Lion Run is an annual half marathon held in Tarnów Podgórny, attracting both elite runners and amateurs. The event is known for excellent organization, an attractive route, and enthusiastic spectator support. As part of the festival, there are also races for children and various accompanying events such as cheering contests and concerts. The Lion Run is a great opportunity for sporting competition and family fun in a beautiful setting.
course_highlights: Half marathon route in Tarnów Podgórny
Pogoń za Lwem 10 km race route
Numerous nutrition points along the route
additional: Registration transfer available until May 10, 2026. Cheerleading contest with a prize of 1000 PLN. Accompanying events: ØRGANEK concert, FOODSTIVAL, Hobby Horse Cup, Stadium track competitions. Large races for children during the festival. Registrations until May 10, start and recovery packages, cheerleading contest, previous edition's race sold out.

name: Bieg Poznaniaka
organizer: Stowarzyszenie na Rzecz Edukacji Dzieci i Młodzieży z Autyzmem „Aperio”
price_range: 60-80 zł dla dorosłych, 40-45 zł dla dzieci

description: Poznaniak Run for Preschoolers is a family running event held on May 23, 2026, in the picturesque Greater Poland National Park and at the Museum of Agriculture in Szreniawa. The program includes main races over distances of 11 km and 5.5 km, Nordic Walking marches, and children's and youth races on various distances. The event is charitable, with all proceeds supporting children with autism. Organizers provide electronic timing, commemorative medals, and numerous attractions for participants and their families, including free museum tours and outdoor games for children.
course_highlights: The main race and Nordic Walking march routes run along a designated loop approximately 5.5 km in Greater Poland National Park
Participants in the 11 km distance complete the loop twice
Children's races take place at the Museum of Agriculture and Food Industry in Szreniawa
additional: Electronic timing for all races except virtual. Each participant receives a commemorative medal. Free tours of the Museum of Agriculture and Food Industry in Szreniawa and participation in outdoor games for children. Access to the start area by car, MPK buses lines 703 and 705, and PKP train to Szreniawa station (150 m walk). Races over 11 km and 5.5 km, Nordic Walking march, children's races, museum tours, electronic timing, commemorative medals.

name: Maraton Sztafet Ekiden
location: Kampus Główny Akademii Wychowania Fizycznego, Białołęka, Warszawa, Poland
description: The 20th Onet Marathon Relay is the largest team race in Poland, taking place on May 23, 2026, at the Main Campus of the University of Physical Education in Warsaw. This unique event brings together runners of all skill levels, where teams of six members collectively cover the marathon distance in the Japanese ekiden relay format. The event promotes team spirit and cooperation, offering various relay change distances that facilitate participation for beginner runners. It is an excellent opportunity for sports competition and integration among friends, families, or colleagues.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Main Campus of the University of Physical Education in Białołęka
The route consists of two loops
Fast and friendly course for teams of six members
additional: Start is organized in waves, with the start time chosen during registration. The race number must be placed at the front of the clothing and be visible. Participants should arrive at the start area early enough to comfortably use deposit points, changing rooms, and toilets. Net time is counted from crossing the start line. Volunteers support the organization and atmosphere of the race, and volunteer recruitment is open. The event promotes cooperation, integration, and team spirit, with various distances and categories for different age groups, including races for children and youth.

name: Nowomiejska Dycha
location: Nowe Miasto Lubawskie, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Nowym Mieście Lubawskim
description: Nowomiejska Dycha is a unique night street race taking place on May 23, 2026, in Nowe Miasto Lubawskie. The route runs through atmospheric and historic streets of the town, offering participants a unique atmosphere and the chance to compete for attractive prizes. The program includes two races: 5 km at 6:00 PM and 10 km at 8:00 PM, both starting and finishing at the Nowe Miasto Market Square. Participants can expect comprehensive start packages, recovery meals, and great fun in a charming setting.
course_highlights: The route runs through atmospheric and historic streets of Nowe Miasto Lubawskie
Night street races with start and finish at the Nowe Miasto Market Square
Two distances: 5 km and 10 km
additional: Start packages include t-shirts, bags, commemorative magnets, and medals. Prizes for the best runners include cash and material awards. Recovery meals will be available after the races. Both races start and finish at the Nowe Miasto Market Square. The event combines a passion for running with joy and community in a charming town. Night race, registration on Superczas.pl, prizes, start packages, festive atmosphere

name: Phoenix RUN
location: Smolarnia, Nowy Tomyśl, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Klub Biegowy Phoenix Contact Wielkopolska i Opalenicki Klub Biegacza
description: Phoenix RUN is a unique sporting event held in a picturesque forest near the Smolarnia forester's lodge close to Nowy Tomyśl. This is the second edition of the race organized by the Phoenix Contact Wielkopolska Running Club, which brings together running and Nordic walking enthusiasts. The event offers a variety of distances for adults and children, promoting active spending time with family and friends. Participants can expect rich start packages, commemorative medals, attractive prizes, as well as integration and a chillout zone.
course_highlights: Main race 10 km in the forest
Nordic walking 5 km for adults
Children's races from 100 to 800 meters
additional: Start and finish at the Smolarnia forester's lodge near Nowy Tomyśl. Children's races start at 9:00 AM, main race and Nordic walking for adults at 11:00 AM. The event offers participant integration, healthy food, a chillout zone, rich start packages, commemorative medals for all, attractive prizes for the best, and a lottery. The event includes 10 km races, 5 km Nordic walking, and children's races from 100 to 800 meters. Participants can enjoy attractions and prizes, with the route passing through the forest, providing scenic views and active entertainment.

name: Sieprawska Piątka
description: The Siepraw Five-Kilometer Run is an annual race organized in Siepraw, attracting runners of various age groups and skill levels. The event takes place in a picturesque area, with the race route passing through the Sunny Park and the Orlik sports complex, offering participants comfortable conditions for competition and recreation. The run is community-oriented and promotes physical activity among residents and visitors. Organizers provide extensive sports infrastructure and support during the event.
course_highlights: The race route passes through Sunny Park in Siepraw
Start and finish located at the Orlik Sports Complex
Well-prepared sports infrastructure with changing rooms and toilets
additional: The organizer is the Municipal Cultural and Sports Center in Siepraw. The Orlik Sports Complex provides sanitary facilities and changing rooms for participants. The event has a community-building character and promotes physical activity among the local community. name: Ultramaraton Jaga-Kora

description: The 45th Jubilee Krotoszyn Run is an annual running event held in Krotoszyn, scheduled for May 30 and 31, 2026. The event features races for children and youth at the Municipal Stadium, as well as main races through the city streets over distances of 10 km and 5 km. The start and finish are located at the stadium, and the route runs through the streets of Krotoszyn, allowing participants to experience the city's atmosphere. The run is an excellent opportunity for families and runners of various skill levels to spend active time.
course_highlights: Route through the streets of Krotoszyn
Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Krotoszyn
Children and youth races at the stadium divided into age categories
additional: Children and youth races take place on May 30 from 2:00 PM at the Municipal Stadium with a warm-up led by a coach. Children's age categories have different distances ranging from 100 m to 1200 m. The race office will be open on May 30 and 31, 2026, where registration is possible if there are available start spots (without a t-shirt). Registrations are open until April 15, 2026, available online with race packages and discounts for residents. The races will be held at the stadium and through the city streets, with various age categories.

name: 5. Półmaraton Szpot Swarzędz
description: The 5th Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon is a unique running event scheduled for May 31, 2026, in Swarzędz. The course consists of two loops totaling 21.097 km, scenic and dynamic, leading around Lake Swarzędz. The race combines sporting excitement with professional organization, a special atmosphere, and spectator support, creating an unforgettable running celebration. As part of the Swarzędz Running Festival, there are also 10 km races and a Family Run, making the event attractive for different age groups and skill levels.
course_highlights: Course around Lake Swarzędz, scenic and dynamic
Two loops totaling 21.097 km
Course sometimes shaded, ensuring comfort during the run
additional: As part of the Swarzędz Running Festival, three races take place: the Half Marathon, 10 km, and Family Run. Participants can purchase a special commemorative T-shirt. The event combines sports, educational, and charitable aspects. The organizer ensures professional organization, safety, as well as unique medals and prizes. The race atmosphere is supported by enthusiastic spectators and extensive media coverage. The course around Lake Swarzędz includes educational and charitable elements, the opportunity to buy a commemorative T-shirt, and is part of the Swarzędz Running Festival.

name: Bieg z okazji Dni Ziemi Ropczyckiej 2026
description: The Ropczyce Earth Day Run is a 10 km race taking place on May 31, 2026, in Ropczyce. This running event is organized on the occasion of the local holiday and attracts runners looking to spend active time on a moderate-distance course. The race route runs through the scenic terrain of Ropczyce, and participants can expect typical May weather with temperatures around 20 degrees Celsius. We invite all running enthusiasts to participate in this event.
course_highlights: Distance of 10 km
Course in Ropczyce, Poland
Typical May weather around 20°C, cloudy
additional: Please verify event details with the organizer before registration. The event includes training preparations, and the route passes through picturesque areas of Ropczyce. May weather usually favors runners, with temperatures around 20°C and average rainfall of 55 mm.

name: Marceliński Bieg Wiosenny 2026
description: Marceliński Spring Run 2026 is cross-country race organized in Poznań by running enthusiasts from the Biegi.Wlkp. group. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the aesthetic qualities of the location. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on popularizing cross-country running in Greater Poland, offering participants a unique running experience in beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Cross-country race on scenic routes in Poznań
Aesthetic qualities of the proposed locations
Route available on Garmin Connect
additional: Authorization form for collecting the start package. The race route is available on Garmin Connect. The event will take place on May 31, 2026 at 10:00 AM. Registration details are not provided, and the route includes the area of Marceliński Forest.

name: Szybka Piątka 5K FAST RUN Kupienino 31.05.2026
location: Kupienino, gmina Świebodzin, Lubusz Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Fast Five 5K FAST RUN is a new running event that will take place for the first time on May 31, 2026, in Kupienin near Świebodzin. The race offers a fast, 5-kilometer distance, ideal for runners seeking a dynamic challenge. The event is organized with running enthusiasts in mind, who want to test their speed on a scenic route.
course_highlights: Distance of 5 km - fast street run
Scenic route around Kupienin
First edition of the event
additional: 5 km races, first edition, local organization

name: 16 Kogeneracja Biegaj w Siechnicach
location: Siechnice, Wrocław County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
price_range: 80-100 zł, z zniżkami dla mieszkańców gminy
description: The 16th Cogeneration Run in Siechnice is a street race on distances of 5 km and 10 km, which will take place on May 31, 2026. The race route runs through the streets of Siechnice, with participants completing a 5 km loop, which those running 10 km do twice. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity, and the recreational values of the Siechnice municipality. In addition to the main races, there are also races for children and youth. The start and finish are located on Kościelna Street at the intersection with Jana Pawła II Street, with the start scheduled for 9:00 AM.
course_highlights: Street route in Siechnice with a 5 km loop
10 km distance is two laps of the 5 km loop
Start and finish on Kościelna Street at the intersection with Jana Pawła II Street
additional: Race office and deposit at Jana Pawła II Street next to the Municipal Office. Pickup of race kits on Saturday and Sunday morning. The race kit includes an Oshee isotonic drink, an Eatyx bar, and a race number. At the finish line, there is a medal and a recovery meal. Participant limit is 700 people. Youth races and the Young Engineer Run for children up to 7 years old. Free parking near the LA Stadium/Błękitna Laguna open from 9:00 to 15:00, recommended parking at the PKP station and Toro Park shopping center. A new system for issuing race numbers with a QR code. The participant limit is 700, with online registration available. The event also includes youth and children’s races, promoting health and recreation.

name: 3 Zduńskowolski Festiwal Biegowy
description: The 3rd Zduńskowolski Running Festival is an anniversary street race through the city of Zduńska Wola, organized on the occasion of the 200th anniversary of granting city rights. The event features races of 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21 km), with start and finish lines located at the Municipal Stadium on Łaska Street. The course runs through the city streets and the Zapolice municipality area to the village of Brzeski in the Sędziejowice municipality, where the turnaround point for the half marathon is situated. Several hundred participants take part in the event, which has an urban and street race character.
course_highlights: Course through the streets of Zduńska Wola
Turnaround point in the village of Brzeski in Sędziejowice municipality
Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium on Łaska Street
additional: Several hundred participants take part in the event. The event is organized by the Zduńska Wola City Office. The half marathon course is 21 km with a turnaround in Brzeski. Available races include 5 km, 10 km, and the half marathon. There is no information about start waves, participant limits, registration fees, or additional services. The event includes races for different age groups and skill levels, as well as attractions for families and participants of all ages.

name: 4 Bieg Zawierciański
location: Stadionie OSIR w Zawierciu, Zawiercie, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Klub Sportowy „Warto Biegać” i Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Zawierciu
description: The 4th Zawiercie Running Race is a running event organized by the Sports Club "Warto Biegać" and the Sports and Recreation Center in Zawiercie. The competition takes place at the OSIR Stadium in Zawiercie and includes two distances: a main race of 10 km and a companion race of 5 km. The race route runs through the streets of Zawiercie, is properly secured and closed to traffic, and each kilometer is marked. The event aims to popularize running and integrate runners from across the country.
course_highlights: Race route through the streets of Zawiercie
Marking of each kilometer of the route
Closure of the route to traffic and security measures
additional: Race office open from 7:00 to 8:30 at the OSIR Stadium, with the possibility of collecting start packages also on Saturday from 16:00 to 19:00. The time limit for 10 km is 1:30, and for 5 km is 1:00. Electronic timing with a transponder chip placed on the shoe. Participants must wear start numbers pinned to the front of their shirts. It is forbidden to move on the route on bicycles, roller skates, skateboards, and other devices without the organizer's permission. Distances are 10 km and 5 km, with a time limit of 1:30 for 10 km and 1:00 for 5 km, start packages can be picked up on the day of the event, route security, a limit of 500 participants, electronic registration from December 6, 2025, to May 15, 2026.

name: Bieg o Koronę Księżnej Dąbrówki
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Dopiewie
description: The Queen Dąbrówka Princess Crown Run is a jubilee, fifteenth edition of the running event traditionally held on the last Sunday of May. The main race over a distance of 10 km runs through forest paths surrounded by greenery, providing pleasant conditions for running on a soft surface. Nordic walking enthusiasts can participate in a 7.5 km route, and younger participants can compete on shorter distances ranging from 200 to 1000 meters. The start and finish are located on the edge of the Palędzko-Zakrzewski forest near Parkowa Street in Dąbrówka. The event is family-oriented and integrative, promoting physical activity among residents of the Dopiewo Municipality.
course_highlights: Main race 10 km through forest paths surrounded by greenery
Nordic walking over 7.5 km
Children's races from 200 to 1000 meters
additional: Children's races start at 10:15 AM, the main race at 12:00 PM, and the Nordic walking march at 12:02 PM. The race office and packet pickup are available in the days prior to the race at the GOSiR Dopiewo sports hall and on the race day on Parkowa Street in Dąbrówka. Individual and team classifications, including classifications for people with disabilities and residents of the Dopiewo Municipality and LINEA Developer estates. Teams must be mixed (women/men). Distances: 10 km, 7.5 km, children's races; start location on the edge of the Palędzko-Zakrzewski forest near Parkowa Street in Dąbrówka; date: May 31, 2026; registrations are already open.

name: Festiwal Biegowy Szpot
description: The Szpot Swarzędz Running Festival is a unique running event scheduled for May 31, 2026. The festival features three races: the 5th Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon, the 13th Szpot Swarzędz 10 km Run, and the 6th Szpot Swarzędz Family Run. The half marathon course consists of two loops around the picturesque Swarzędzkie Lake, while the 10 km race offers a dynamic profile with forest accents and city streets. The event combines sport, education, and charity activities, with participants enjoying a rich gastro zone, partner expo, recovery meal, massages, and a charity auction. The festival is open to everyone, including participants in active wheelchairs and seniors over 70 years old, who can start free of charge.
course_highlights: Half marathon course: two loops around Swarzędzkie Lake
10 km course: dynamic profile with forest accents and streets of Swarzędz
Event includes three races and offers a rich gastro zone and expo
additional: Participants aged 70+ have a free start package for the 10 km and half marathon. Limited edition commemorative T-shirts available for runners and families. Debut of active wheelchair athletes in the 10 km race. After the race, recovery meal, stretching, and massages at the finish line, as well as a charity auction. The area includes the surroundings of Swarzędzkie Lake, with discounts for families and veterans, and new accessibility amenities.

name: Krakowski Bieg Swoszowicki
description: The Krakow Swoszowicki Run is a family running event organized in the beautiful Spa Park in Swoszowice, in the south of Krakow. It offers a variety of competitions: the main 10 km race, a 5 km race, a family mile, and races for children aged 1 to 11 years. The event combines generations, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, as well as integrating residents of Krakow and the surrounding areas. Besides sports competition, participants can enjoy attractive start packages and a family picnic.
course_highlights: Main 10 km race through the streets of Swoszowice district X and surrounding areas
Family mile on a 1.6 km distance with intergenerational rivalry
Races for children from 50 to 300 meters, adapted to different age groups
additional: The start package includes gadgets from sponsors, a race number, and a commemorative medal upon completion. Identification and signed declarations are required when collecting the package. The race takes place on the weekend before Children's Day, and the program also features a family picnic. The event supports sick children, is held in the beautiful location of Spa Park, and enjoys high attendance and cooperation with the city of Krakow.

name: LoveLasTrail
description: Love'Las Trail Przystań is a unique forest run held in the picturesque Mazovian forests, in the heart of the Ostrołęka Forest District. This sports and recreational event combines competition with a love for nature, promoting a healthy lifestyle and social integration. Routes of varying difficulty are available for runners at different levels of advancement, as well as for families and Nordic Walking enthusiasts. The atmosphere of the run is full of positive energy and respect for nature, as confirmed by participants of previous editions.
course_highlights: Cross-country routes in the heart of Mazovian forests of varying difficulty
Scenic forest trails around the Ostrołęka Forest District
Distances from a family-friendly 2 km to a challenging run of about 20 km
additional: Race office open from 7:30 to 9:30. Start times for individual distances: 08:00 Forest Deer Marathon (42 km), 09:00 King of the Forest (about 20 km), 10:00 Winds Run (5 km) and Wolf Route (10 km), 10:05 Jackal Nordic Walking (5 km), 10:15 Green Adventure (family run/walk 2 km). The registration fee includes a start number, a returnable chip, a commemorative gadget, a medal, a recovery meal, and a sweet treat. For distances of 5 km, 10 km, 20 km, and Nordic Walking, an Open classification for Women and Men is conducted with trophies for the best. Participants have access to training plans and support, and the event includes various race categories, including marathon, 20 km, 10 km, 5 km, and a family run. Registration is open until May 25, 2026.

name: Mazowiecka Piętnastka
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Mińsku Mazowieckim
description: The Mazovian Fifteen is a jubilee, 30th edition of the national street race organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Center in Mińsk Mazowiecki. The event will take place on May 31, 2026, and is a perfect opportunity for a sporting celebration in a picturesque city. The race is street-based and attracts runners from all over Poland, offering an attractive route and professional organization.
course_highlights: Street route in Mińsk Mazowiecki
Jubilee, 30th edition of the race
Organizer: MOSiR Mińsk Mazowiecki
additional: street race, date May 31, 2026, Mińsk Mazowiecki, PZLA certification, registration closed

name: Mokotowski Bieg SGH
description: The Mokotowski SGH Run is the largest charity run organized by students in Poland, combining sport with helping those in need. The event takes place in the heart of Mokotów, Warsaw, and attracts hundreds of participants — students, alumni, residents, and running enthusiasts. The race route runs through the streets of Mokotów with the finish line in the SGH Rector's Gardens, and every step has a real impact on the lives of those in need thanks to the support of the 'Akogo?' Foundation. It is not only a sporting event but also a community, solidarity, and the energy of student engagement.
course_highlights: Routes of 5 km and 10 km through the streets of Mokotów
Finish line in the SGH Rector's Gardens
Run for children and entire families
additional: The event includes a meeting and attractions zone for partners, a joint warm-up before the start, and medal awards after the race. The run has a charitable character, with proceeds going to the 'Akogo?' Foundation supporting people in a coma. The event promotes community integration among students and residents of Warsaw, encouraging a healthy lifestyle and helping others.

name: Rio de Janeiro Virtual Challange
description: The Rio de Janeiro Virtual Challenge is a virtual event that takes you on a route through the vibrant streets and breathtaking landscapes of Rio de Janeiro, known as the Marvelous City. Participants can track their progress using a mobile app, logging various physical activities that are automatically converted into distance covered. The challenge offers the flexibility to choose your own pace and duration, as well as individual or team participation. Additionally, for every progress made in the challenge, organizers plant trees or prevent plastic bottles from reaching the ocean, supporting environmental protection.
course_highlights: 198 km (123 miles) route through Rio de Janeiro
8 virtual postcards to unlock during the challenge
Integration with popular fitness apps and smartwatches
additional: Participants have access to a private Facebook group where they can share experiences and motivate each other. The challenge allows logging of any distance-based activities, including yoga or weightlifting. Participants can choose their own start date and challenge duration. Access to a mobile app on iOS and Android for tracking progress. Participants can complete the challenge at any time; medals and apparel are available, and participation supports ecological initiatives.

name: Stryszów w Biegu
description: Stryszów Municipality invites you to the sporting event "Stryszów Run," which will take place on May 31, 2026. The race route runs through picturesque areas of the municipality, including fields, forests, and views of Lake Mucharskie and surrounding hills. The event offers three distances suitable for different skill levels: 6 km for families and beginners, 10 km for runners seeking a challenge, and a 21 km mountain half-marathon for experienced competitors. The goal of the event is to promote physical activity, integrate residents, and showcase the natural attractions of the region.
course_highlights: The route runs through fields and forests
View of Lake Mucharskie
Hilly and mountain character of the half-marathon
additional: Three distances: 6 km, 10 km, 21 km; limit of 300 participants; start and finish at the LKS "Chełm" Stryszów facility; online registration until May 24; the event promotes physical activity and the natural attractions of the region.

name: UltraPark Weekend
description: UltraPark Weekend is an ultra running festival taking place in Pabianice from May 29 to May 31, 2026. The event features three main competitions: UltraPark 48h, UltraPark 24h, and UltraPark 100 km, which are also the Polish championships in their categories. The races attract long-distance runners, offering challenging routes and a unique competitive atmosphere. The organizer is the Sports Club "O Co Biega" from Pabianice.
course_highlights: Routes of UltraPark 48h and UltraPark 24h
UltraPark 100 km route
Event held in Pabianice
additional: The event includes various ultramarathon distances, with opening and closing ceremonies during the 48-hour race; registration details are not yet available

name: V Półmaraton Po Kolei
location: Lemany, Szczytno County, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Powiatowe Centrum Sportu, Turystyki i Rekreacji w Szczytnie

tiers.description: Opłata startowa jest równa 100 PLN. Zgłoszenia elektroniczne przyjmowane będą do godziny 23:59 w piątek 22 maja 2026 r. lub do wyczerpania limitu.

description: The 5th Kolei Half Marathon is a race approximately 21.1 km long taking place on May 31, 2026, in Lemany near Szczytno. The route runs along a bike path on an old railway line and municipal roads, offering scenic views and well-equipped hydration and nutrition points. The event is organized by the District Sports, Tourism, and Recreation Center in Szczytno and the Local Tourism Organization of Szczytno County. In addition to the half marathon, there are children's races and a 5 km run, making the event attractive for various age groups and skill levels.
course_highlights: Route along a bike path on an old railway line
Hydration points at 5.5 km, 10.5 km, and 16 km
Nutrition point at 10.5 km of the route
additional: The start package includes a bib number, a commemorative T-shirt, a finisher medal, and a timing chip (to be returned at the finish line). Minors must present written consent from legal guardians. The organizer provides a meal and water for all participants. The participant limit is 150 paid entries. Cash prizes are awarded to the top three finishers in the Open categories for women and men, as well as in additional categories such as uniformed services and county. The race promotes physical activity; participants receive medals and T-shirts. Online registration is available. The event takes place along the old railway line route.

name: X Charytatywny Gminny Bieg Między Wiatra...
description: The 10th Municipal Charity Run Between Windmills is an annual running event held in Łukaszów, aimed at promoting running, sports, and a healthy lifestyle. The run is charitable, and all proceeds are donated to support those in need. The course runs along a scenic loop around the windmills in Łukaszów, and participants can choose from several distances, including a children's run, 5 km, 10 km, and Nordic Walking. Organizers provide electronic timing and a warm meal and drinks for participants.
course_highlights: Loop around the windmills in Łukaszów
5 km and 10 km courses with a time limit of 1 hour and 30 minutes
Children's run approximately 500 meters on the recreational square
additional: The participant limit is 200 people across all distances. Timing is provided by Sports Timing Poland using electronic chips worn on the leg. Chips must be returned after the run or a fee of 50 PLN applies for loss. Participants must check in at the race office, open from 8:30 to 10:35. The organizer provides a warm meal, cakes, water, coffee, and tea for participants. The event is a municipal charity run scheduled for May 31, 2026, supporting local initiatives.

name: XI Sieradzki Cross Towarzyski
location: Park Miejski im. A. Mickiewicza, Sieradz, Łódzkie, Poland
description: Sieradzki Cross Towarzyski is an annual running event organized by the Sieradz Biega Sports Club, promoting running and integrating the running community of Sieradz. The race takes place in A. Mickiewicz City Park on a 2 km loop covered with gravel, marked every 500 meters. The event lasts 6 hours, during which participants compete to complete as many laps as possible, with the option to take breaks and return to the course. The event is social and promotional in nature, and participants receive electronic lap and time measurement.
course_highlights: 2 km loop in A. Mickiewicz City Park in Sieradz
100% gravel surface
Lap markings every 500 m
additional: The race runs from 11:00 to 17:00, participants can pause and resume at any time but must stay within the designated transition zone during breaks. Each participant receives a returnable start number with a chip for electronic lap and time measurement. The participant limit is 250 people. Minors (ages 16-17) can participate with parental consent and can run up to 10 km (5 laps). The race involves running on a 2-kilometer park loop, with electronic timing, commemorative medals, awards for the best, and starter packs.

description: TAURON Run for Angels is a charity run organized in Katowice that supports the beneficiaries of the Guardian Angels House. The event takes place in Kościuszko Park and combines sports with helping children in need. Participants can choose the main 5 km run, children's races in various age categories, and a virtual run. The entire registration fee is donated to support educational, therapeutic, and upbringing activities for nearly 600 children from difficult backgrounds. The event also features a family picnic full of attractions, and each participant receives a commemorative medal and a gift.
course_highlights: Main run over 5 km in Kościuszko Park in Katowice
Children's races in various age categories
Opportunity to participate in a virtual run from anywhere
additional: Children aged 0-6 can accompany a guardian on the main route free of charge after prior registration via the form. The event also includes a full-day Family Picnic with attractions. Prizes and trophies are awarded for the top three places in the men's and women's categories as well as in children's races. The registration fee is a donation and is non-refundable. The 5 km distance includes various age categories, children's races, a virtual run, family attractions, with registration deadlines on May 15 and May 27.

description: The XIV Kurdeszowa (Za)Dyszka in Kostrzyn is an annual race organized by the Municipal Sports, Tourism, and Recreation Center in Kostrzyn. The event features distances of 10 km and 5 km for running, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking walk, with open, age, and local resident classifications. The start and finish are located at Powstańców Wielkopolskich Street near Primary School No. 2 in Kostrzyn. The organizer plans to hold a raffle for tangible prizes for participants, and the race office is open a few hours before the start.
course_highlights: Distances: 10 km run, 5 km run, and 5 km Nordic Walking walk
Start and finish at Powstańców Wielkopolskich Street near Primary School No. 2 in Kostrzyn
Classifications: OPEN, age-based, and for residents of Kostrzyn municipality
additional: Race office open from 15:00 to 16:30. The organizer plans to hold a raffle for a tangible prize worth at least 500 PLN among all race participants. Mini Kurdeszowa Za(Dyszka) are children's races on distances from 100 m to 800 m depending on age categories, with commemorative medals for all participants. The event also includes training sessions, prize draws, and is part of local sports attractions.

name: XXXIX Bieg Stolemów
location: Stadion 'Arena Mistrzów', Gniewino, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Kaszubskie Stowarzyszenie Kultury Fizycznej Żukowo oraz Gminny Ośrodek Turystyki i Sportu w Gniewinie
description: The 39th Stolem Run is an annual 10 km race organized at the 'Arena Mistrzów' Sports Stadium in Gniewino. The event also includes races for children and youth, a 5 km Nordic Walking march, and a recreational walk-run. Participants can enjoy electronic timing, medals for all participants, and prizes for the best. For those wishing to participate virtually, there is an option for a virtual run from May 27 to June 4, 2026.
course_highlights: Main race over 10 km with certification
Nordic Walking march over 5 km
Children's and youth races over shorter distances
additional: The event begins with the opening of the race office at 11:00 AM, where start numbers and chips are issued. A café, deposit, and changing facilities are available. The preschool run of 80 meters is free, and every participant receives a medal. The recreational walk-run over 1200 meters requires no registration and is free of charge. Participants are classified into 15 age categories. On-site registration for the 5 km and 10 km races is possible. A free bouncy castle is available for the youngest participants, and there is coffee and cake from KGW Perlino on site. Participants can choose from various distances and age categories, and the event also features attractions and decorations at the stadium.

name: Świętokrzyski Bieg Europejski
description: The Świętokrzyski European Run is a 5-kilometer street race held in Kielce, promoting physical activity and the spirit of the European community. The race course runs through the city streets, offering participants a sporting challenge in a friendly atmosphere. The event is part of the Funduszowego Maja 2026 activities in the Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship, encouraging movement and local community integration.
course_highlights: 5-kilometer street course in Kielce
Race promoting physical activity and European spirit
Organized as part of Funduszowego Maja 2026 in Świętokrzyskie
additional: Street race in Kielce, 5 km, event as part of Funduszowego Maja 2026.

name: Wydminy Night Run 5K
location: Wyspa Wydmińska, Wydminy, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Wydminy Night Run 5K is a night run organized on Wydminy Island in Wydminy. The event attracts runners who want to challenge themselves with a 5-kilometer course in a picturesque setting. The run is recreational and sports-oriented and is an excellent opportunity for active recreation and local community integration. Organizers ensure a unique atmosphere and unforgettable experiences during the night run.
course_highlights: 5 km course on Wydminy Island
Night run in a scenic, natural environment
Organized as part of the local community of Gmina Wydminy
additional: The event takes place in the evening, starting at 19:00 and ending by 23:00. Registration opens on April 20, 2026. Participants can expect the atmosphere of night running in the beautiful scenery of Wydminy.

name: 12. Tarczyński Nocny Wrocław Półmaraton
location: Tarczyński Arena Wrocław, Wrocław, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 12th Tarczyński Night Wrocław Half Marathon is one of the most important sporting events in Wrocław, scheduled for June 6, 2026. Participants will run a new, wide, and safe route starting and finishing at Tarczyński Arena Wrocław. The half marathon symbolizes activity, health, and the openness of the city, attracting runners from all over Poland and abroad, as well as numerous spectators. description: The Zawojski Mountain Running Festival is one of the largest sporting events in the region, taking place in the picturesque scenery of Babiogóra and the Policy Range. The festival attracts runners from all over Poland and abroad, offering a variety of mountain running distances and a unique atmosphere. The goal of the event is to popularize mountain running and promote the beauty of Babiogóra National Park, combining sporting adventure with exploring the region's natural and cultural richness.
course_highlights: Ultra route 63 km with an elevation gain of 3340 m
Mountain marathon route 42.9 km with an elevation gain of 2060 m
Picturesque views of Babiogóra and the Policy Range
additional: Participant limits for individual distances: 63 km - 200 runners, 42.9 km - 200 runners, 21.097 km - 300 runners, 6.2 km - 250 runners. Starts are scheduled at different times: ultra at 5:00, marathon at 10:00, half marathon and 6.2 km run at 15:00. The maximum time limit for the longest distance is 15 hours, for the marathon 10 hours, for the half marathon 3.5 hours, and for the 6.2 km run 1.5 hours. Short races for children are organized on distances from 100 m to 800 m, adapted to age. Routes range from 6 km to 106 km, with participant limits from 200 to 300, various distances and elevation gains, including mountain running and Nordic walking competitions.

name: 23 Wilcza Dycha
location: Osieczna, Powiat choszczeński, województwo zachodniopomorskie, Poland
description: Borowiacka Dycha is an annual 10 km race organized by the association Biegające Śliwice. The event promotes an active lifestyle and attracts runners from the region, offering a scenic route in the Tuchola Forest surroundings. The race takes place in Osieczna and is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich. Participants can expect professional organization and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km course
Scenic Tuchola Forest terrain
Race held in Osieczna
additional: The event is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich series, with the chance to win a unique collection as part of the series. Participants can look forward to sporting competition and attractive prizes.

name: 4 Skolwińska Mila
description: The 4 Skolwińska Mile is an annual street race held in Szczecin, attracting both adults and children. The event takes place on June 13, 2026, continuing the tradition of previous editions, offering participants the opportunity to compete over a short distance. The race is an excellent opportunity for active recreation and community integration. Organizers provide easy contact through a registration form and administrative support.
course_highlights: Distance of 1 mile (1609 meters) on a scenic recreational area
Online registration and timing by Sport-Time
Prizes for the best and medals for all finishers
additional: The event also features children's races over approximately 200 meters. Participants can use the registration form available on the website, which allows quick contact with the organizer and system administrator. Participants can utilize training plans from 8 to 20 weeks, the event is supported by a local hardware store, and the participant limit is 60 people.

name: 7 Szamotulska Nocna Piątka
description: Szamotulska Night Five-Kilometer Run is an annual, officially certified 5 km race held in Szamotuły. The route runs through the city streets, providing participants with the opportunity to compete at a professional level with recognized results. The event is open to everyone, including children and families, who can participate in accompanying races on shorter distances. The main race starts in the evening, giving the event a unique, nocturnal character. Organizers ensure participant comfort by offering refreshments after the race and decorations for the winners.
course_highlights: Certified route by the Polish Athletic Association
Night race starting at 21:55
City route running through Szamotuły streets
additional: On race day, a temporary traffic organization is in place with parking difficulties and designated detours. Race packets are issued from 17:00 to 21:30. After the race, participants are offered refreshments and winners are decorated. There are 26 free start packages available for disabled persons in the family race with a guardian upon email registration. The event includes road closures and detours, and offers various distances, including 5 km, 255 m, and 555 m. Participants can find updates and information on the official website and Facebook page.

name: 8 Bieg Chwalisza
description: The 8th edition of the Chwalisz Run is an annual charity race taking place on June 13, 2026, in Ściernia. The start and finish are located at Kindergarten No. 1 - Ściernia branch. The 5 km route mainly runs through forest paths with minimal asphalt, offering challenges and joy of running for both experienced athletes and beginners. All entry fees are dedicated to supporting Antoś Synowiec, a child with a rare genetic disease, highlighting the charitable nature of the event. Organizers also invite participants to joint training sessions every Thursday at 7:00 PM.
course_highlights: 5-kilometer route with minimal asphalt
Forest sections full of challenges
Start and finish at Kindergarten No. 1 - Ściernia branch
additional: Professional timing measurement with accuracy to hundredths of a second. The event combines sport with charity support. Joint training sessions every Thursday at 7:00 PM from the kindergarten in Ściernia, ul. Kamienna 17. A family festival accompanies the race. The 5 km route includes forest sections, charity event, family festival, and training sessions on Thursdays at 7:00 PM.

name: Bieg Iskry
description: Airplane Run is a unique running event taking place on June 13, 2026, at the Mielec airport. Participants will cover a 6.5 km route along the runway under lit lights and a setting sun, creating a distinctive aviation atmosphere. Organizers provide professional medals, T-shirts featuring the Iskra airplane motif, and awards in the form of statuettes and vouchers for tandem flights. After the race, participants can admire aircraft and enjoy refreshments and dietary supplements.
course_highlights: 6.5 km route along the Mielec airport runway
Run under lit lights and sunset
Start, finish, and decorations in the hangars of the White-Red Wings Foundation
additional: Participants will receive running T-shirts with the Iskra airplane, commemorative medals, as well as statuettes and diplomas in open and age categories. Medical and sanitary facilities are provided. At the end, there will be a raffle for a glider flight funded by the Polish Aviation Foundation. The event partner is DepilConcept salon, which offers a voucher for photodepilation treatments for the first woman to finish. Airport area, online registration, medals, T-shirts, prizes, aviation attractions, recovery meals.

name: Bieg Recepta na Zdrowie
location: Łódzki Park Arturówek, Łódź, Łódzkie, Poland
description: The eighth nationwide 'Prescription for Health' run will take place on June 13, 2026, in Arturówek, Łódź. It is a healthy running event promoting physical activity, integration of the running and pharmaceutical communities, and a healthy lifestyle. The race routes run along a 5 km loop in Łagiewnicki Forest, with distances of 5 km and 10 km, as well as Nordic Walking on a 5 km route. Shorter races for children and youth are scheduled on the same route. A family picnic with free health screenings and consultations will be held near the start and finish areas.
course_highlights: Race and Nordic Walking route on a 5 km loop in Łagiewnicki Forest
Two laps of 5 km for the 10 km distance
Family picnic with blood pressure and sugar measurements and consultations
additional: Start and finish at the recreational facilities of Arturówek, race office open from 8:00 AM on race day. The 5 km run and Nordic Walking start together at 10:00 AM, children's and youth races at 12:00 PM, 10 km run at 1:30 PM. The route is not certified. Awards and medals for children and youth immediately after their races. Registration for children requires an account on zapisy.inessport.pl. The event is supported by organizers from the pharmaceutical industry, with a strong emphasis on promoting a healthy lifestyle and health prevention, taking place in June 2026 in Łódź, at Arturówek.

name: Biegi w Rogoźniku
organizer: Gminne Centrum Kultury i Sportu w Bobrownikach
description: Rogoźnik Running Races is an annual running event held in the picturesque town of Rogoźnik. The competition offers a variety of routes, including races for children and youth, as well as courses of 8.4 km and 15.5 km. The event is supported by local institutions and sponsors, and participants can expect professional organization and a friendly atmosphere. It is an excellent opportunity to spend active time outdoors and engage in sports competition.
course_highlights: Routes of 8.4 km and 15.5 km
Races for children and youth
Picturesque terrains of Rogoźnik
additional: Start list available online. Support from local institutions and sponsors. Race routes available as maps on the website. Races for children and youth organized concurrently with the main races. Different distances and routes, online registration, support from local sponsors and institutions.

name: Leśna ZaDyszka
location: Leśnictwo Szulmierz, gmina Regimin, Mazowieckie, Poland
description: Leśna ZaDyszka is a race organized in the picturesque Szulmierz Forest in the Regimin municipality, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle in forested areas. The route consists of a 5 km loop through forest paths and a paved section, showcasing the beauty of Masovian nature. Participants can choose from three races: 5 km, 10 km (two loops), and Nordic Walking over 5 km. There is also a 1.5 km race for children without classification. The start and finish are located on a forest clearing by the Szulmierz-Regimin road, and the time is measured with a professional chip system.
course_highlights: 5 km loop route through forest paths and asphalt
Views of Masovian nature and deer breeding
Route secured by volunteers
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 AM on the forest clearing by the Szulmierz-Regimin road. Participants receive a commemorative medal and a recovery meal after the race. There is an option to choose a standard T-shirt at the price or a Premium LAS T-shirt with a surcharge of 20 PLN. Time is measured with chips attached to footwear. Prizes are awarded for places in age categories and open, as well as a raffle among participants. The routes include forest paths and asphalt, with various distances and categories, including races, Nordic Walking, and Cross Duathlon. Starting fees depend on the registration period.

name: Memoriał Mariana Szymańskiego
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Radomsku
description: The 13th Radomszczański Street Run Memorial of Marian Szymański is an annual running event organized in Radomsko to commemorate Marian Szymański. The race takes place on the city streets, offering participants the opportunity to compete in a friendly atmosphere. The organizer is the City of Radomsko and the Municipal Sports and Recreation Center in Radomsko, with timing provided by Timing Measurement Atelier Sportu. The race is scheduled to start at 5:30 PM, and online registration is open until June 10, 2026.
course_highlights: Street run over a distance of 10 km
Participation in the memorial honoring Marian Szymański
Organized by MOSiR Radomsko with electronic timing
additional: Event scheduled for June 13, 2026, start at 17:30, online registration until June 10, 2026, race on the streets of Radomsko

The event is aimed at runners of different experience levels who want to spend active time and compete on a moderately challenging course. The race is divided into heats based on the forecasted times of participants, allowing for efficient organization and competition at an appropriate level. The organizer is the Athletics Sports Club Maków Mazowiecki, and the participant limit is 200 people. We invite all runners over the age of 15 to participate in this sporting event.

location: Zagwiździe, Gmina Murów, Opole Voivodeship, Poland
description: The XII Provincial Cross Country Race for the Borsuk Cup is a running event organized by the Municipality of Murów, which will take place on June 13, 2026, in Zagwiździe on the grounds of the historic Ironworks complex. The competition includes various categories, such as a 12 km run, a 3.5 km run, children's races, and Nordic Walking. The race office will be open from 8:00 AM to 9:30 AM, and timing will be recorded electronically. This sporting event combines competition with a beautiful, historic setting, encouraging physical activity and social integration.

Available distances: 12 km, 3.5 km, children's races, and Nordic Walking
Electronic timing ensuring accurate results
additional: Race office open from 8:00 AM to 9:30 AM. Categories include a 12 km run, a 3.5 km run, children's races, and Nordic Walking. Organizer is the Municipality of Murów.
