name: XIX Bieg Marszałka
description: The XIX Marshal's Run is an annual street race organized in Sulejówek, commemorating the traditions of pre-war Sulejówek - Belweder marches. The main race, approximately 10 km long, takes place in June, referencing Józef Piłsudski's settlement in Sulejówek. The event also features accompanying races, including the Halina Zielińska Memorial of about 3.6 km and races for children. The race has a patriotic and sporting character, with participation of uniformed services and museum staff, and the start and finish are located at 94 Paderewskiego Street, next to the Bzów Villa.
course_highlights: Main race approximately 10 km through Sulejówek streets
Halina Zielińska Memorial approximately 3.6 km
Traditional start and finish at Bzów Villa, 94 Paderewskiego Street
additional: The main race and Halina Zielińska Memorial start at 10:20, Toddler Race at 10:30, Senior Race at 10:40. Flower laying ceremony at the Marshal Józef Piłsudski monument at 9:50. Possibility to purchase start packages officially and securely. Participants include uniformed services and museum staff in separate classifications. Registration and package pickup at the Józef Piłsudski Museum, with registration available via email. The event includes various distances and competition formats, including races for children and seniors.

name: XV Bieg Szlakiem Króla Zygmunta Starego

course_highlights: Course referencing the historical path of King Sigismund the Old
Picturesque landscapes of Kozienice and surrounding areas
Well-marked and prepared running route
additional: Registration for the event is available online; the event attracts nearly 180 runners, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in the region.

The event takes place in the evening, starting at 6:00 PM, and participants can use the city parking lots near the amphitheater.

Start and finish at the municipal amphitheater on Grodzieńska Street 31
Additional 5 km race and 400 m race for children

Participants in categories M65, M70+ and K60+ for the 10 km race, as well as M65+ and K60+ for the 5 km race, are exempt from the start fee. Participants can take advantage of free entries in categories M65+, M70+, K60+. Registration is conducted via the platform Time2go.pl. The race takes place on asphalt, and the event is held in the evening, making it an attractive sporting and social event in the region.

name: Dziki Trail
description: Dziki Groń is a challenging mountain route of the Pieniny Ultra-Trail® run, guided by tourist, courier transfer, and through the Małe Pieniny meadows. The race offers scenic views of the Tatra Mountains and the Beskid, with start and finish lines located at Plac Dietla in Szczawnica. The course is designed for experienced mountain runners who want to face natural, demanding terrain. The event is part of the Pieniny Ultra-Trail mountain running festival, which promotes an active lifestyle and the Pieniny region.
course_highlights: Route guided by tourist and courier transfer trails
Views of the Tatra Mountains and Beskid
Passing through the Małe Pieniny meadows
additional: Start and finish at Plac Dietla in Szczawnica. Race office and EXPO located in Park Górny in Szczawnica. There are 5 refreshment points along the route, including one at 12 km near the Shelter. Mandatory equipment required according to the regulations. The event promotes an active lifestyle and the Pieniny region. Registration opens in November 2025, event date is June 14, 2026. The course length is approximately 64 km. The event takes place in Szczawnica, featuring mountain trails and the Małe Pieniny meadows.

The race commemorates the patron of the local high school, Juliusz Słowacki, and promotes a healthy lifestyle and sports activity among residents. The half marathon route is flat, runs through the city streets in two loops, with numerous refreshment and nutrition points. After the race, participants receive medals and can enjoy a hot meal and drinks. The event is also an opportunity to promote the city and the local running community.
course_highlights: Flat route, through city streets, two loops of about 10.5 km each

Four nutrition points and four refreshment points on each loop

Training from the moment of registration until the event.

description: The 13th Cichociemnych Run is a cross-country race organized in Sochaczew, dedicated to the memory of Polish heroes, the Cichociemni soldiers. The race route is challenging, featuring numerous natural and artificial obstacles of varying difficulty levels, which require participants to get wet in water, jump, and squeeze through obstacles. The race takes place once a year in June and attracts people who want to test their limits and are not afraid of mud. It is a unique opportunity to get closer to the banks and bed of the Bzura River and feel the wind in your hair during sporting competition.
course_highlights: Cross-country route with natural and artificial obstacles
Run along the bank and bed of the Bzura River
Challenging elements: mud, water, channels, jumps, and squeezing through
additional: Registrations are conducted through the Zmierzymy Czas platform. Starting fees increase as the event date approaches and depend on the payment date. There is an option to order a race-specific T-shirt at selected times. For running groups (minimum 6 people), a discount is available with prior email contact. Payments must be made within 30 days of registration. The organizer is UKS Dragon Fight Club Sochaczew. terrain, online registration, obstacles, demanding route

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The 17th Mysłowice Grand Prix is a series of races organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, promoting a healthy and active lifestyle as well as integrating runners from the region and beyond. The event takes place on a fixed route that is well known to participants, and the atmosphere is friendly for both experienced runners and amateurs. The event attracts numerous groups of runners, Nordic walking enthusiasts, and canicross participants, and participation is free of charge. The organizers ensure good organization and support the development of the local running community.
course_highlights: Fixed route with over 100 races in history
Routes for runners, Nordic walking, and canicross
Participants from many cities of the Upper Silesian Agglomeration and beyond the voivodeship
additional: Registrations for the GP series are only possible at the Race Office on the day of the race. Participation in the Grand Prix series events is free. The events also include participants in Nordic walking and canicross. There is a high participation of women, ranging from over 27% to 34% in individual races. A shared atmosphere and integration of runners from different clubs and cities. The event is scheduled for June 27, 2026, with the possibility of online registration. It promotes health, activity, and good fun in a sporting atmosphere.

name: XXI Dziesiątka Unisławska
description: The 21st Unisław Ten is an annual race covering a distance of 10 km, along with a Nordic Walking march, organized in Unisław on the occasion of Unisław Days. The race route runs on asphalt roads through the picturesque Chełmiński Landscape Park, passing through the towns of Unisław, Stablewice, and Gołoty. The race is certified by the Polish Athletic Association (PZLA) and is part of the Kujawsko-Pomorskie Voivodeship Long-Distance Running Grand Prix 2026. We invite all running and Nordic Walking enthusiasts to participate in this sporting event.
course_highlights: Route runs through Chełmiński Landscape Park
10 km distance with PZLA certification
Passes through Unisław, Stablewice, Gołoty
additional: The race and Nordic Walking march will take place on June 27, 2026. The race routes are on asphalt roads. The race is part of the Kujawsko-Pomorskie Voivodeship Long-Distance Running Grand Prix - Edition 2026. An additional Nordic Walking competition is available, with marked routes and medical services on site. The race starts at 10:00 AM, and participants can enjoy nutritional points along the route.

organizer: Urząd Gminy Czernichów i Stowarzyszenie Bajeczne Beskidy
description: The 27th Żar Mountain Run is a mountain race covering a distance of 10 km, scheduled to take place on June 27, 2026, in Międzybrodzie Żywieckie. It is an excellent opportunity for mountain running enthusiasts to challenge themselves with a demanding course and test their fitness. Organizers encourage preparation with training plans tailored to various skill levels. The race combines athletic competition with the beauty of mountain scenery.
course_highlights: Mountain trail of 10 km
Picturesque views around Międzybrodzie Żywieckie
A challenge for runners of different skill levels
additional: Organizers offer training plans from 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to the runner's VDOT level, with instructions and expert support. Educational materials on warm-up, diet, and motivation for running are also available on the website. The distance is approximately 8.5-10 km, mountain terrain, on-site registration, includes a cable car ticket as a prize.

description: The 37th Świętojański Cross named after Jan Marek in Pogórze is a traditional race organized by LKS Pogórze, scheduled to take place on June 27, 2026, at 6:00 PM. The event is held in the picturesque town of Pogórze and attracts runners who appreciate competition on trail routes. The organizers provide professional RFID timing measurement and comprehensive technical support, ensuring a smooth event. We invite all running enthusiasts to participate in this special sporting event.

Professional RFID timing measurement
Start at 6:00 PM, allowing for a pleasant evening run
additional: Registrations close on June 21, 2026, at 11:59 PM. The organizer provides electronic timing at the start and finish lines, an electronic LED clock at the finish, and real-time results on the website. The race office services and bib number distribution are handled by the organizer. Registration ends on June 21, 2026. The event is open to various age groups, and the route likely runs through outdoor terrains in Pogórze.

description: The Great Izerska Loop is a scenic half marathon held as part of the Izerski Running Weekend in Szklarska Poręba. The route runs through the streets of the town and along the trails of the Izerskie Mountains, offering runners contact with nature and mountain scenery. The race is recreational and sports-oriented, promoting physical activity and popularizing running. Participants use electronic timing, and the time limit to complete the course is 3 hours.
course_highlights: The route runs through the streets of Szklarska Poręba and along the trails of the Izerskie Mountains
The surface of the route includes paved paths and forest roads
Finish line at the Municipal Stadium on Plac Sportowy in Szklarska Poręba
additional: Timing is measured with a chip mounted in the start number, which cannot be removed. The time limit to complete the course is 3 hours from the start. Participants shortening the route are disqualified. The event includes various distances, including 5 km, 10 km, and Nordic Walking, with online registration and routes in mountain terrains. It has been held since 2013, featuring well-known athletes and course records.

name: XVIII Bieg w pogoni za żubrem
description: The XV Run in Pursuit of the Bison is an annual running event held in Niepołomice, attracting runners of various distances. The competition offers routes of 8 and 15 kilometers as well as a race for children, making the event appealing to a wide range of participants. The race course runs through scenic areas, combining athletic competition with the beauty of the surrounding nature. It is an excellent opportunity to spend active time and compete in a friendly atmosphere.

Longer 15-kilometer route for more advanced runners
Special race for children promoting physical activity among the young
additional: forest terrain, registration via form on the website, sports and recreational event

description: Izery Ultra-Trail is a unique mountain race held in the heart of the picturesque Izera Mountains, with start and finish in Świeradów-Zdrój. The routes of varying lengths and difficulty levels lead through wild, unknown terrains, offering participants unforgettable views and challenges. The event attracts both experienced ultramarathon runners and trail enthusiasts who want to face demanding terrain and the beauty of nature. Organizers provide full support at nutrition points and necessary equipment, ensuring safety and comfort for participants.
course_highlights: Routes lead through wild and unknown terrains of the Izera Mountains
Start and finish in the heart of Świeradów-Zdrój, in the Spa Park
Significant elevation gains: up to +2650 m on the longest route of 100 km
additional: Start and finish in the Spa Park in Świeradów-Zdrój. Routes equipped with nutrition points (6 on 100 km, 4 on 50 km). Mandatory equipment includes, among others, a water cup, hat or headscarf, rain jacket, water container with a minimum capacity of 1 liter, elastic bandage and sterile dressing. Participants receive a start number with a chip, route maps, and a GPS device with the route loaded. An active phone for contact throughout the race. Start and finish in Świeradów-Zdrój; registrations for 2026 began at the beginning of the year; the event includes various distances, including Ultra 50, Ultra 70, and Ultra-Trail® 100.

name: Kresowe Trail #7
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of intimate, non-commercial trail runs held in the picturesque natural surroundings of Eastern Poland and Vilnius Region. The race routes pass through pristine forests, varied ascents, sand, and roots, offering challenges for both beginners and experienced runners. The competition takes place over two distances: the shorter Szpurt (approximately 7 km) and the longer Wertep (approximately 17-21 km), which is an ultra-distance race. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, respect for nature, and the integration of runners from different backgrounds.
course_highlights: Routes pass through forests with natural obstacles: ascents, sand, and roots
Routes are marked according to standard cycling markings with clear arrows and ribbons
Scenic views and rich nature, as well as the multicultural heritage of the region
additional: The races are held in an intimate atmosphere with a limited number of participants for safety and environmental protection. Competition is conducted in overall and team classifications, with awards for the best competitors in age categories. The routes are easy to navigate thanks to markings, and the event promotes physical activity in a healthy, forest environment. As part of the Kresowe Trail series, a minimum of six races must be completed to qualify; registration details are not provided.

name: Roztoczański Festiwal Biegowy
location: Kresowa Osada, Basznia Dolna, Lubaczów, Poland
description: Roztoczański Festival of Running 2026 is one of the largest running events in the Roztocze region, organized by the Lubaczów Municipality. The three-day festival takes place in Basznia Dolna, at the Kresowa Settlement, which serves as the start and finish point for all races and Nordic walking marches. Participants can choose from ten different distances, ranging from night runs and Nordic walking marches to ultramarathons and half marathons, passing through the scenic areas of the Land of Lubaczów. This event combines sporting competition with a festival atmosphere, attracting both experienced runners and amateurs.
course_highlights: Trails lead through characteristic landscapes of the Land of Lubaczów and Roztocze
Start and finish located at the Kresowa Settlement in Basznia Dolna
Diverse distances from 5 km Nordic walking march to approximately 60 km ultramarathon
additional: The festival lasts three days: Friday features a Night Run of 7 km and a 5 km Nordic walking march; Saturday includes an approximately 60 km ultramarathon, the 39th Lwów Infantry Regiment Memorial Marathon, a marathon relay 4x10.5 km, and a Nordic walking relay; Sunday offers a 30 km run, the Crystal Goblet Half Marathon, a 10 km run, and a 10 km Nordic walking march. The event attracts many participants and spectators, with registrations available on the platform dostartu.pl. 10 distances, festival atmosphere, catering facilities, diverse routes, and regional attractions.

location: Wyspa Bolko, Opole, Opole County, Poland
description: The 24th Atlantis Opole Race is an annual run held since 2003 on the first Saturday of July on Bolko Island in Opole. The race route runs through a designated zone of silence and greenery in the city center, offering participants the opportunity to compete over distances of 5 km and 10 km. Since 2015, the race has been called Atlantis Opole Race, thanks to the support of Atlantis-Deweloper. The event is organized by the Opole Running Association, which promotes physical activity and sports integration within the local community.
course_highlights: Route on Bolko Island - a green and quiet zone in the center of Opole
Two distance options: 5 km and 10 km
Race takes place on the first Saturday of July, traditionally since 2003

The association involves people of different ages and encourages cooperation in organizing the event. The event takes place in urban areas, including streets and parks, with registration available at designated locations. The race enjoys great interest from the local community and attracts participants from various regions.

name: Grill+Run-Fun

The competition lasts 8 hours, during which participants face endurance challenges and enjoy contact with nature. The event is organized by the Luxtorpeda Association and attracts long-distance endurance enthusiasts. The event also features races for children, emphasizing its family-friendly character. The start and finish are located at the Orzeł Palowice sports field.

Time format - an 8-hour race
Family races for children during the event

Award ceremonies are planned for 4:30/5:00 PM. During the event, children's races in memory of Jacek Kostrzewa are also organized. The event includes grilling and participant integration, online registration is available, and the route runs through picturesque forest areas of Palowice.

The event attracts hundreds of runners from various cities, offering a unique atmosphere and a running challenge during nighttime hours. The half marathon route takes runners through charming parts of the city, providing unforgettable experiences. The event has its tradition and is very popular among amateur and professional runners.

Sporting celebration atmosphere with hundreds of runners

Participants run for 25 hours, and each kilometer covered brings them closer to achieving this goal. It is not only a sports challenge but also an opportunity to work together for children in need.

name: Ultramarathon Górski - 3 x Sniezka = 1 x Mont Blanc
description: The Mountain Ultramarathon 3 x Śnieżka = 1 x Mont Blanc is a demanding mountain race held in Karpacz, which also serves as a qualifier for the prestigious UTMB and is a member of ITRA. Participants can choose from three distances with varying difficulty and elevation gain, earning ITRA points. The route runs through the scenic trails of the Karkonosze Mountains, including multiple ascents of the Śnieżka peak, offering challenges for experienced ultramarathoners as well as opportunities for beginner mountain runners.

Scenic trails of the Karkonosze Mountains with aid stations along the route

description: The 12th Night Port Marathon Szczecin and the 7th Night Port Half Marathon Szczecin are nocturnal street races held in Szczecin, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. name: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko
description: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko is a unique trail run taking place on July 18, 2026, on the picturesque terrains of the Elbląg Upland by the Vistula Lagoon. The route passes through wild trails, varied elevations, and a quiet, natural scenery, offering runners contact with nature and the region's history. The event is part of a nationwide mountain running series promoting physical activity in harmony with nature, suitable for both beginners and experienced ultramarathoners. Participants can expect professional organization, medical support, and a rich race package.
course_highlights: Wild nature of the Elbląg Upland with scenic elevations
Routes passing through the Elbląg Upland Landscape Park and four forest reserves
Views of the Vistula Lagoon and historic sites such as Old Prussian hillforts and the Imperial Stone
additional: The race package includes a waterproof bib with a chip, medical support, trail marking, nutrition points, drinks and snacks at the finish line, a commemorative medal, and a GPS tracker for the 81 km distance. Starts are scheduled in waves from 5:00 AM (81 km) to 10:30 AM (14 km), with separate races for children called Garmin Junior. An online technical briefing on Facebook will be held on July 15, 2026, at 8:00 PM. The system offers discounts when registering for more than one event in the series. The event also includes junior categories and challenge options, with routes passing through reserves and tourist trails, providing unique experiences for runners and nature enthusiasts.

The events take place on Saturdays, once a month, on a 4219.5-meter route in the municipal forest, with start and finish at the Piast stadium. The event promotes a healthy and active outdoor lifestyle, encouraging regular physical activity under the slogan "Let yourself be provoked to fight laziness!".

name: Pogórze Ultra Trail
description: Pogórze Ultra Trail is a mountain race organized by the Pogórze Ultra Trail Association, which combines a passion for running and exploring the natural beauty of the Pogórze Strzyżowskie region. The race routes lead through picturesque areas with diverse natural features, including old deciduous forests, thickets, loess ravines, and unique rock formations. Participants have the opportunity to run through historic shelter tunnels in Strzyżów and Stępin, as well as admire the Brzeżanka mountain range, the Kiczora massif, Herby, and Chełm Hill. It is the largest running event in the region, attracting trail and ultramarathon enthusiasts every year.
course_highlights: Routes lead through the Brzeżanka mountain range and Kiczora massif
Passing through shelter tunnels in Stępin and Strzyżów
Picturesque Pogórze Strzyżowskie with forests, ravines, and rock formations
additional: In 2026, the competition will be held over 4 distances. Finisher area will feature new elements. The organizers are a group of running and photography enthusiasts who take care of logistics and timing. The routes include unique historical and natural elements of the region. The event attracts trail running lovers, offering beautiful views, local supporter presence, and professional organization.

name: XRUN - Ucieczka Św. Kingi
location: Krościenko nad Dunajcem, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: St. Kinga's Escape is a mountain trail run held in Krościenko nad Dunajcem, connecting the scenic routes of the Sądecki Beskid and Pieniny mountains. Participants can choose distances from 14 km to 40 km, with various time limits and starts on Sunday morning. The 40 km route passes through Przysłop, the Shelter at Przechyba, Wielka Przechyba, as well as through Pieniny National Park, ending with a viewpoint trail along the Dunajec River. The event is organized by the Beskid Foundation and takes place at the amphitheater in Krościenko nad Dunajcem.

The event includes various trail distances, with routes leading through mountain trails, with online registration available. Start and finish are located in Krościenko nad Dunajcem, and the event is part of the XRUN mountain running series.

The event includes races for children and youth, a 10 km race, and special accompanying runs such as the Health Resort Sea Mile. Organizers provide a rich program and attractive prizes, and the race route runs through charming health resort areas.

This jubilee edition attracts participants of various age groups and skill levels. Organizers invite all interested to participate, emphasizing the charitable nature of the event.

Nordic Walking as an integral part of the event

The run promotes physical activity as part of rehabilitation and support for the ill, as well as social integration.

Route marked every 1 km with signs

name: Jurajskie Mistrzostwa NA SKRAJU PRZEŁAJU
description: Jurassic Championships ON THE EDGE OF CROSS-COUNTRY are demanding cross-country races held in the picturesque Przewodziszowice near Żarki, in the Jura Krakowsko-Częstochowska region. The routes lead through Jurassic hills, limestone outcrops, dense forests, winding paths, rocky ascents, and open spaces with a view of the Jurassic Landscape Park. The event offers various distances, from short races for beginners and Nordic walkers to the challenging Trentaraton for experienced runners. It is an excellent opportunity for sporting competition and enjoying the beauty of nature.
course_highlights: Jurassic hills and limestone outcrops
Winding paths and rocky ascents
Panorama of the Jurassic Landscape Park
additional: Race office open on August 30, 2026 from 8:00 to 10:00. Registrations available until 24.08.2026 online, and from 24.08.2026 only on the day of the event at the office. Children can participate free of charge. The event also includes Nordic Walking marches over distances of 14 km and 7 km. Distances range from 7 km to 30 km, with races for children, on-site registration from 8:00, Jura terrain, runs and walks, sporting and recreational event.

name: 47. Półmaraton Szczecin Bieg na 10 km
location: Plac Jasne Błonia im. Jana Pawła II, Szczecin, Poland
description: The 47th PKO Szczecin Half Marathon is an annual running event held on August 30, 2026, in Szczecin. Participants can choose between the half marathon distance (21.0975 km) or a 10 km run, which takes place on a single loop through the city streets. The start and finish are located at Jasne Błonia Square named after John Paul II. The route is certified by PZLA and is marked every kilometer, with electronic timing using chips embedded in the race bibs. Organizers offer wave starts and high-quality technical shirts from the Ventus brand in extended packages.
course_highlights: Single-loop route through Szczecin streets
Distance selection point at 9.6 km of the route
Route certified by PZLA, marked every 1 km
additional: Participants can choose between a basic or extended package with a Ventus technical shirt. Start and finish at Jasne Błonia Square named after John Paul II. Participant limit is 6000 people. Electronic timing with chips in race bibs. Wave start options available. Courier packages shipped via InPost with the option to redirect to a parcel locker. Distances: half marathon and 10 km run; location: Jasne Błonia, Szczecin; date: August 30, 2026, from 09:00 to 13:00.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznan
location: Jezioro Kierskie, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznań is a prestigious triathlon held at the historic Lake Kierskie, the site of Poland's first triathlon event in 1984. Participants can enjoy calm and warm waters for swimming, a fast and flat cycling route through picturesque villages and the western part of Poznań, and a run leading towards the city center with a finish at the International Fairgrounds Poznań — a modern symbol of the city. This unique event combines athletic competition with local culture and modern infrastructure.
course_highlights: Swimming in the calm and warm Lake Kierskie, site of Poland's first triathlon
Flat and fast cycling route through villages and the western part of Poznań
Run leading towards the city center with a finish at the International Fairgrounds Poznań
additional: Start in a rolling start format. The start and finish locations are Lake Kierskie and the International Fairgrounds Poznań. The IRONKIDS event will take place the day before, on August 29, 2026, starting at 11:00. Registration for the main race is sold out; notifications about additional spots are available. Participants have the option to change their start date free of charge within the Flex90 offer. The event also includes accompanying activities such as Night Run and IRONKIDS, with a participant limit of 1500. Registration requires a credit card.

name: Kresowe Trail #10
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of intimate trail runs organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in nature. The series takes place on scenic routes in eastern Poland, respecting nature and local communities. The events are suitable for both beginners and experienced runners, aiming to build a community based on passion, competition, and friendship. The events are non-commercial and intimate, with a limited number of participants to ensure safety and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: Trail routes through picturesque forests and hilly terrains in eastern Poland
Respect for nature and local communities
Intimate character with a limited number of participants
additional: The runs are intimate with a limited number of participants. The organizer provides electronic timing, medical support, refreshment stations along the course and at the finish line, and commemorative medals. Participants can earn points towards the overall classification and titles of Finisher and Super Finisher for completing multiple races. The organizer encourages environmental respect and litter-free trails. The event focuses on the trail community, promotes outdoor activity, and supports the development of the local running scene. Registration is conducted via an electronic platform, and the event is part of a series covering various locations.

The half marathon route passes through representative hotels and sanatoriums, the picturesque Spa Park, and charming promenades, giving the race a unique atmosphere. The time limit to complete the 21.0975 km distance is 3 hours and 30 minutes, and the race is open to both experienced runners and amateurs.
course_highlights: The route runs past representative Busko hotels and sanatoriums
Race through the picturesque Spa Park and charming promenades
Unique atmosphere and scenic surroundings of the route

Registration is open until May 31, 2026. The start is at 8:30 AM, with a time limit of 3 hours and 30 minutes. The route includes urban and park areas.

name: Leśna Piątka Odwrotnie

The race route is run in a different direction than usual, allowing participants to experience it anew. The event is open to runners, Nordic Walking enthusiasts, and mixed pairs, with medals for all finishers and trophies for the best in various categories. The race is the finale of the Forest Five season and part of the Tour of Running in the Area - TurBO, encouraging activity throughout the year.

Start and finish at the parking lot on Słupska Street in Koszalin
Race in the reversed direction of the route to experience it anew

Route suitable for intermediate difficulty level

name: RAWki na Surowo
location: Bieszczadzki Park Narodowy, Wetlina, Bieszczady, Poland
description: RAWki na Surowo is a mountain trail race held in the magical Bieszczady Mountains, leading through the scenic Mała and Wielka Rawka meadows. The 29 km course with an elevation gain of +1550 m runs through the Bieszczady National Park, which necessitates a race format without aid stations and trail marking. The event is certified by ITRA and UTMB and is part of the MTrail Running Series league. The start and finish are located in Wetlina, and the race is conducted in a self-support format, emphasizing its raw character.
course_highlights: 29 km course with +1550 m elevation gain through Mała and Wielka Rawka meadows
Self-support race format without aid stations and trail marking
Runs through Bieszczady National Park with views of the Polish-Ukrainian and Polish-Slovak borders

The race office is open on September 4th from 18:00 to 21:00 and on September 5th from 06:30 to 07:30. The time limit to complete the course is 15:30. The start and finish are approximately 1300 meters apart, with participant parking available in Wetlina, including near the green trail to Jawornik. The race is conducted without aid stations or hydration points; participants must be self-sufficient. The main distance is approximately 28.5 km, with limited access due to park regulations. The event also includes online registration and electronic timing.

description: The 60th Race Walking Festival is a prestigious international sporting event organized in the port region of Gdańsk, scheduled for September 5, 2026. The event gathers competitors across various age categories and skill levels, offering race walking competitions over distances of 10 km (women and men, including Open, U20, U18 categories), 5 km, and 3 km for younger participants, as well as the Polish Masters Championships over 5 km. The festival also features the Polish U23 Championships over 10 km and accompanying events such as the Prologue "Walking with the Postman" and the Memorial Run for the Polish Post Defenders - Energa Cup. The organizer, the LECHIA Gdańsk Athletics Club, promotes physical activity among people with disabilities by organizing wheelchair races and FrameRunning competitions.
course_highlights: Race walking over distances of 10 km, 5 km, and 3 km tailored to different age categories
Polish Masters Championships 5 km and Polish U23 Championships 10 km

additional: The festival promotes activity among people with disabilities through wheelchair races and FrameRunning competitions. The event encourages sports activity among different age groups and people with disabilities, with support from the Ministry of Sport and Tourism.

description: Praga Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Warsaw, attracting both amateurs and experienced runners. Runners can enjoy a variety of surfaces and beautiful views of the Baltic Sea, as well as the exceptional atmosphere of the Usedom island.

The course was modified in 2022 to reduce the number of inclines, making it more participant-friendly. The event has a unique sporting atmosphere, combining competition with recreation for entire families in a natural setting. The race commemorates Tomasz Hopfer, a legend of Polish sports journalism and an athlete, and also promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity within the local community.

Eco-forest surroundings of the course in Obliwice

The event attracts up to 5,000 runners and is both a sporting challenge and a tribute to the Coast Defenders of 1939.

Professional electronic timing measurement
Support from local institutions and partners, including the Municipal Pools "Termy Jakuba"
additional: Race office open on September 5 from 16:00 to 20:00 and on September 6 from 07:00 to 09:15. Acceptance of the regulations and consents related to personal data processing is required. It is possible for a third party to collect the race pack after giving the appropriate consent. The race office is located the day before the race, online registration is available, and the participant limit is 891.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Radków 2026
location: Radkowskie Lake, Radków, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
distance_verbose: 50 mil, Ultramaraton, Maraton, 24 km, Półmaraton, 10 km
description: Garmin Ultra Race Radków 2026 is a mountain trail run taking place in the picturesque surroundings of the Table Mountains, near Radkowskie Lake. The routes lead through rocky labyrinths, technical trails, and beautiful rock formations such as Szczeliniec Wielki and Błędne Skały. The event attracts both beginners and experienced ultramarathon runners, offering various distances and a unique atmosphere close to nature. Radków is an ideal place for a sporting adventure and relaxation amidst nature.
course_highlights: Spectacular trails of the Table Mountains with rock formations
Routes leading around Szczeliniec Wielki and Błędne Skały
Proximity to Radkowskie Lake as a place for recovery
additional: Ceremonies for awards are held after the completion of each distance. Starting packs are distributed at designated times before the start and during the event. Starts are staggered, with the longest distance beginning at 05:00, and shorter distances starting in subsequent hours. There are also Garmin Junior races for children in various age categories. Participants can enjoy the EXPO and have the option to track results online and download completion certificates. Trail running, multiple distances, registration details, scenic mountain terrain, event dates September 11-13, 2026.

name: 10. PKO Bieg Charytatywny
description: The 10th PKO Charity Run is a nationwide initiative that combines sporting excitement with tangible support for an important social cause – mental health of children and youth. The event will take place on September 12, 2026, across Poland, encouraging participants to run together and act for the community. Every lap, kilometer, and minute on the route matters, emphasizing the idea of community and help. This anniversary edition invites runners to actively participate and support.
course_highlights: Multiple locations in Poland, including Gdańsk, Ruda Śląska, Łomża, Krosno, and Stalowa Wola
Virtual run option with an app
Relays and runs for children and adults for charitable purposes
additional: The event takes place across Poland, combining sports activity with a charitable goal for the mental health of children and youth. The PKO Charity Run is an initiative where not only the result matters but primarily collective action and social support. The event supports children's and youth's mental health, includes relay races and fundraising for therapies, and features participation in many Polish cities as well as virtual participation.

name: Bieg 7 Dolin
location: Piwniczna-Zdrój, Nowy Sącz County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 7 Valleys Run is a mountain ultramarathon covering a distance of 100 km, taking place in the picturesque Beskid Sądecki, with start and finish in Piwniczna-Zdrój. The route runs through challenging mountain trails with significant elevation gain, offering participants exceptional views and contact with nature. The event is part of the Running Festival, which combines sports competition with regional promotion and active lifestyle. The time limit to complete the course is 19 hours, and there are food and drop-off points along the route. This is a challenge for experienced mountain runners who want to face difficult but beautiful terrain.
course_highlights: Elevation +3740 m / -3740 m over 100 km
6 food points and 3 drop-off points along the route
The route runs through Beskid Sądecki trails with views of mountains and the Poprad valley
additional: The time limit to finish the race is 19 hours (until 9:00 PM). Intermediate cut-off times at checkpoints are: Rytro (36 km) - 7 hours (by 9:00 AM), Krynica (62 km) - 12 hours (by 2:00 PM), Wierchomla (89 km) - 17 hours (by 7:00 PM). Recommended technical equipment includes, among others, a reusable cup or bottle, a backpack or running belt, NRC foil, a headlamp, reflective elements, health insurance, a whistle, hand sanitizer, and an active phone with ICE number recorded on the back of the bib. The event features various distances, including 100 km, 42 km, 61 km, 23 km, and 11 km, with accompanying attractions such as festivals and expo. The race will take place in early September 2026.

name: 5 Aktywna Piątka
price_range: 100 zł w dniu zawodów, wcześniejsza rejestracja
description: The 5th edition of the "Active Five" race will take place on September 12, 2026, in Frydek, Miedźna Municipality. It is a fast street race on a course certified by the Polish Athletic Association (PZLA) with a length of exactly 5 km, starting at 11:00 AM. As part of the event, the Silesian Voivodeship Championships in the 5 km run will be held, with a participant limit of 600 people. Additionally, there is a Family Run for children and youth up to 15 years old on three distances.
course_highlights: Fast, PZLA-certified 5 km course
Asphalt route marked every 1 km
Watering points and water curtains along the route
additional: The main race participant limit is 600 people. In the OPEN classification, the top 5 women and men are awarded. The race starts at Modowa Street 189C. The accompanying Family Run is intended for children and youth up to 15 years old, with three distances: 800 m for ages 10-15 and shorter distances for younger age groups. Only registered main participants of the family run receive a commemorative medal. The limit of paid participants is 400. No participation with a dog, wheelchair, or stroller is allowed.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: Grand Prix Truchtacza in Mysłowice is a series of races organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, promoting a healthy and active lifestyle as well as the integration of runners from different regions. The event is open to everyone, regardless of skill level and age, and participants can compete in running, Nordic walking, and canicross. The races take place on forest and urban routes, creating a friendly atmosphere of sporting competition and community. The Grand Prix is a tradition and passion that has united runners for many years.
course_highlights: Forest routes over Bolina
Various competitions: running, Nordic walking, canicross
Participants from many cities and sports clubs of Silesian Voivodeship and Lesser Poland
additional: Registrations for the Grand Prix series are only possible at the Race Office on the day of the race. Participation in the Grand Prix events is free of charge. The events are open to both runners and participants in Nordic walking and canicross. Athletes from different cities and sports clubs take part, with women accounting for over 27%. The event includes various distances and seasonal competitions, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity within the local community.

name: II Złotowska Dziesiątka
description: The 2nd Złotów Ten Kilometer Run is a street race taking place on September 13, 2026, in Złotów. Participants complete two loops of 5 km each, totaling a distance of 10 km. The event is organized by the Złotów Social Activity Center and aims to promote an active lifestyle and integrate the local running community. We invite all running enthusiasts to participate in this event.
course_highlights: The route consists of two loops of 5 km each
Street race in the center of Złotów
Organized at the Municipal Stadium and surrounding streets
additional: The race takes place at the Municipal Stadium in Złotów and the surrounding streets. The route includes two loops of 5 km. Registrations are conducted through the Domtel-Sport platform. The organizer provides contact and support through the Złotów Social Activity Center. The 10 km street race offers online registration, is supported by local companies, features an attractive route, and prizes.

name: Poznań Track Day 2026
location: Tor Poznań, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Poznań Track Day is a series of exciting motorsport events held at the race track in Poznań. Participants have the opportunity for competitive racing, training, and eliminations across various rounds scheduled for the 2026 season. The event is aimed at motorsport enthusiasts, offering also the possibility to rent cars and receive individual training sessions with instructors. It is an excellent opportunity to experience racing thrills and improve skills on a professional track.
course_highlights: Race track in Poznań with professional infrastructure
Opportunity to participate in various rounds and eliminations of the 2026 season
Options for training and individual instructor-led coaching
additional: Car rental options available for personal use or as a gift. The starter package includes participation for a team member, the possibility of co-driving (age >17), full catering, individual timing measurement, and training options with an instructor. Payments for participation must include the appropriate title format to confirm attendance. Multiple rounds including training, eliminations, and night races; focus on sporty driving and excitement on the track.

name: XI Bieg Nadziei oraz VII Mistrzostwa Wielkopolski Prawników
location: Środa Wielkopolska, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 11th Hope Run and the 7th Greater Poland Lawyers Championships is a charity run organized in Środa Wielkopolska, supporting the activities of the Piotr Hospice. The event combines sporting competition with an important social goal, engaging the local community and the legal environment. It is a well-established event that promotes physical activity and solidarity.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Old Market Square in Środa Wielkopolska
Charity run supporting the hospice
Various distances and activities, including runs for children and Nordic walking
additional: The run is charitable in nature, supporting the Piotr Hospice. Registrations open on March 1, 2026. No details about the route, start times, or fees are available on the website. The event is planned for September 13, 2026, and includes different forms of running and activities, with participation supporting the activities of the Piotr Hospice.

name: XRUN - Vistula Trail
location: Wisła, Cieszyn County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Vistula Trail is a mountain trail run organized in Wisła, offering a variety of distances from short routes for children to demanding mountain trails. Participants can experience scenic views of the Beskidy Mountains, starting both in the center of Wisła and on the Czech side in Třinec. The routes lead through characteristic points such as Soszów Wielki, Soszów Shelter, and Czantoria, combining an international adventure with the Beskid climate. This event is for mountain running enthusiasts who appreciate diversity and the beauty of natural landscapes.
course_highlights: Start in the heart of Wisła at the Skolnity Ski & Bike Park
The route passes through Soszów Wielki, Soszów Shelter, and Czantoria
Scenic descents along the green trail to the center of Wisła and Kopczyński Park
additional: Time limits for the routes: 35 km - 9h, 24 km - 7h, 15 km - 4h. Starts are scheduled at different times: 35 km at 07:00, 24 km at 08:00, 15 km at 09:30. Age categories for children from 3 to 15 years are available on short distances. Start and finish in Wisła, with transportation to the start of the Classic Trail from Třinec. The event offers various distances divided into age categories, organized transport for some routes, marked trails, and a category for children. The start is in a picturesque area with the possibility to enjoy mountain scenery.

name: 16 Bieg Częstochowski
description: The 16th Częstochowa Run is a street running event scheduled for September 13, 2026, in the center of Częstochowa. The 10 km route runs through the city's representative streets, including the area around Jasna Góra, which gives the race a special prestige. The race has official certification, attracting competitors focused on fast pace and personal bests. It is an excellent opportunity for sporting competition in a picturesque urban setting.
course_highlights: 10 km route through the center of Częstochowa
Course passes near Jasna Góra
Official certification of the route conducive to fast running
additional: Registration takes place at the Sports Hall of IV Liceum, payment in cash. The event also includes training sessions and information from sponsors.

name: Bieg na Skałę
organizer: Centrum Kultury, Sportu i Rekreacji w Skale
price_range: 30 zł do 19.09.2025, 50 zł w dniu zawodów, 120 zł w dniu biegu
description: The Run to the Rock is a unique sporting event that combines physical activity with the beauty of nature in Ojców National Park. The race route runs through picturesque paths and hills, offering participants varied terrain, including forest trails, rocky sections, and steep ascents. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners who want to experience the spirit of adventure and enjoy fresh air. After the race, participants will receive commemorative medals, prizes, and numerous attractions, including entertainment for children. The entire event takes place in a friendly, sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Route through charming paths and hills of Ojców National Park
Varied terrain: forest trails, rocky sections, steep ascents
Amazing views of the surrounding area
additional: Available distances: Pstrąg Ojców Run (8 km) with team classification and a prize for the best resident of Skała municipality, and the Trail of Rocks and Valleys Run (15 km) with similar classification. For children, races are scheduled at distances of 100 m (ages 2-5, no classification), 800 m (ages 10-11), and 1300 m (ages 12-15). After the race, attractions for the youngest include inflatable castles, entertainers, and competitions with prizes. The route includes charming paths and hills, with diverse terrain from forest trails to rocky sections and steep ascents. The event features races at various distances, including for children, with the option to download GPX files, and start packages can be collected on September 19-20, 2025.

name: Chyża 10
location: Nowy Tomyśl, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The XII Chyża Ten is a fast and popular 10 km race organized by the Nowotomyski Biegacz Club Chyży. The event takes place in Nowy Tomyśl and is part of the Grand Prix of the Nowotomyski County in running. The race is scheduled to start at 9:00 AM, and the race office is open from 7:00 AM to 8:30 AM. The race attracts both amateurs and more experienced runners, offering a friendly atmosphere and a well-prepared route.
course_highlights: Fast 10 km route
Part of the Grand Prix of the Nowotomyski County
Start at 9:00 AM, race office open from 7:00 AM
additional: Race office open from 7:00 AM to 8:30 AM. Winners' ceremony at 10:45 AM. The race is co-financed by the Gmina Nowy Tomyśl and the Nowotomyski County. The event also includes 5 km runs, with registration opening on June 1, 2025. The race is part of a series of sporting events organized by the club.

description: The North Running Festival is a unique running event taking place on September 13, 2026, on the Hel Peninsula, combining the tradition of the North Marathon and Marathon Relays under one banner. The race route runs through picturesque locations of Hel, Jastarnia, and Rozewie, along the Puck Bay, with views of the sea and four lighthouses, which give the race a distinctive character. The event offers a variety of distances for runners of all levels, from marathons and relays, through half marathons, 10 km, and 5 km, to a children's run - Little Lighthouse Runner. It is not only a sport event but also a journey through beautiful coastal corners and contact with nature.
course_highlights: The route runs along Puck Bay with a view of the sea
There are four lighthouses on the route: in Hel, Jastarnia, and two in Rozewie
The route leads through the most beautiful corners of the Hel Peninsula and the coast
additional: The race route is available in .GPX, .KML, and .TCX formats for download. Registration is open from January 1, 2026, to August 24, 2026, until 3:00 PM. Co-organizers and partners include local sports and cultural centers and a holiday resort. Honorary patronage by the Marshal of the Pomeranian Voivodeship. The Little Lighthouse Runner is dedicated to children and youth up to 14 years old. The route is available for download in .GPX, .KML, .TCX formats; marine and seaside terrain; the event includes various distances and competitions for adults and children.

name: XV Półmaraton Damak
description: The XV Damak Half Marathon in Tarczyn is a family celebration of running that guarantees a great atmosphere and unforgettable experiences. The half marathon route runs through scenic areas along fields, forests, and apple orchards, giving the race a unique character. The event attracts runners of all ages, offering also children's and youth races. Organizers take care of participants by providing attractive start packages and sponsor support.
course_highlights: The route runs along fields, forests, and apple orchards
Scenic areas provide a unique race atmosphere
Family event with races for children and youth
additional: Start packages include eco-friendly bags, reflective bands, and thermal mugs with the sponsor Fakro logo. The start packages also contain Kamis spices. The limit for children's and youth races is 150 participants. The race office is located at ul. Szarych Szeregów 8 in Tarczyn. Urban area, online registration, family event, local sponsors and partners.

name: XXI Radomski Maraton Trzeźwości
location: Jedlnia-Letnisko, Kozienice County, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Radomski Marathon of Sobriety is an annual running event organized by the Association "Biegiem Radom!". The race takes place on scenic routes through the Kozienice Forest near Jedlnia-Letnisko, offering participants the opportunity to compete in a marathon, half-marathon, and other accompanying runs. The marathon promotes a healthy lifestyle and sobriety, as well as integrating the local running community. This event with an established tradition attracts both amateurs and experienced runners.
course_highlights: Routes run through Kozienice Forest
Picturesque forest trails and natural surroundings
Available distances: marathon and half-marathon
additional: Participants can personalize medals for a symbolic fee of 10 PLN. The organizer encourages participation in the marathon, half-marathon, and other accompanying runs. The "Biegiem Radom!" association also conducts integration and promotional activities for running in the region. The event includes various distances, including marathon and half-marathon, with training plans and support for participants. Registration opens from September 14, 2025.

name: Żyrardów w Biegu
description: Żyrardów w Biegu is an annual running event organized by the Żyrardów Cycling Society, which will take place on September 13, 2026, by the Żyrardów Reservoir. Participants can choose between two distances: 10 km and 5 km, which run around the reservoir with multiple laps and finish on the reservoir grounds. The race promotes physical activity, integration, and a friendly sporting atmosphere, as well as supports the promotion of the city of Żyrardów and the Mazowsze region. The event is open to adults, and on the 10 km distance, active wheelchair users can also participate.
course_highlights: Route around the Żyrardów Reservoir
4 laps for the 10 km distance, 2 laps for the 5 km distance
Start and finish located at the Żyrardów Reservoir, ul. Ziołowa 17
additional: Online registration is available until September 10, 2026. After this date, registration is only possible at the event office until 9:00 AM on the day of the race. Each participant receives a start number with a chip at the event office. For the 10 km race, active wheelchair users can participate. The event base, start, finish, and parking are located at the Żyrardów Reservoir, ul. Ziołowa 17. Distances: 10 km and 5 km, online registration, a time limit of 100 minutes for the main race, wheelchair start options, and a swimming area available during the weekend of the event.

name: Maraton 3 Jezior / Three Lakes Marathon
location: Międzybrodzie Bialskie, Żywiec County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Maraton 3 Jezior is a mountain running festival held in the picturesque region of the Small Beskids, in the Soła River valley. The main distance is an ultramarathon approximately 43 km long with an elevation gain of about 2485 meters, leading through the highest parts of the Small Beskids, with beautiful views of three lakes and surrounding mountains. The route combines challenging ascents and technical descents, giving participants the opportunity to experience both wild nature and historic sites of the region. The event takes place during the beautiful transition period from summer to autumn, which further emphasizes the charm of the route and the area.
course_highlights: Ultramarathon route approximately 43 km long with an elevation gain of +/- 2485 m
Views of three lakes: Międzybrodzkie, Tresna, and the surrounding area
Technically demanding ascents and descents, including a steep climb to Magurka and the Czupel peak
additional: Start and finish: start at 8:00 AM in Międzybrodzie Bialskie, finish at the stadium in Porąbka. Time limit for the route: 10 hours 30 minutes. The route passes through diverse terrains: forests, meadows, a suspension bridge over the Soła River. There are refreshment points and a spectator zone in Czernichów. The route is technically challenging with significant elevation gain. The festival also offers other distances and accompanying races. The event includes various distances, a festival atmosphere, electronic timing, and routes that lead through lakes and mountains, providing unforgettable experiences.

name: 23 Przejście Dookoła Kotliny Jeleniogórs...
location: Jelenia Góra, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Walk Around the Jelenia Góra Basin is one of the most recognizable long-distance hiking events in Poland, organized since 2004. Participants cover approximately 140 km around the Jelenia Góra Basin, traversing the ranges of the Karkonosze, Janowickie Rudas, Kaczawskie Mountains, and Izerskie Mountains. The event commemorates GOPR rescuers, and as part of the start fee, participants receive start materials, a gadget, a hot meal, and a certificate. The route is demanding, with a total ascent of about 5500 meters, and the time limit to complete the route is 48 hours.
course_highlights: Long route approximately 140 km around the Jelenia Góra Basin
Total positive elevation gain of about 5500 meters
Crossing the ranges of Karkonosze, Janowickie Rudas, Kaczawskie Mountains, and Izerskie Mountains
additional: No time measurement or classification. The start fee includes start materials (number, route map), a logo gadget (t-shirt), a hot meal and drinks at the refreshment point, water at selected control points, a certificate, photographic coverage, prize draws, and GOPR security. Long distance, mountain terrain, difficult weather conditions, memorial in honor of GOPR rescuers.

name: 3 Backyard Ultra Zagłębie
description: Backyard Ultra Zagłębie is a unique ultramarathon held on a loop measuring 6.706 km around Lake Pogoria 3 in Dąbrowa Górnicza. Participants start every hour, and the last runner in each round continues running until only one winner remains. The route combines various surfaces - asphalt, dirt and forest trails, and a beach section, requiring participants to have both endurance and technical precision. The event is the finale of the Polish Backyard Ultra League and attracts extreme challenge enthusiasts from all over Poland.
course_highlights: Loop of 6.706 km around Lake Pogoria 3
Mixed surfaces: 60% dirt and forest trails, 40% asphalt, cobblestone, and concrete
Beach section approximately 250-300 meters near the pier and stairs at the finish
additional: Start of each round occurs exactly on the hour. A participant must arrive at the start within 3 minutes of the round's beginning, otherwise they are eliminated. The race village is located at the Summer Sports and Water Activities Center. The organizer reserves the right to modify the route due to weather or safety reasons. All participants except the winner receive the title DNF (Did Not Finish) as a symbol of perseverance. Participant limit: 140; start at 12:00; location: Dąbrowa Górnicza; ultramarathon format with hourly loops.

name: 17. PKO Bytomski Półmaraton
organizer: Klub MKS MOSM Bytom, Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Bytomiu, Centrum Handlowe Plejada
description: The 17th PKO Bytom Half Marathon is an event promoting a healthy lifestyle and the integration of the local community of Bytom and surrounding areas. The race takes place on an accredited, asphalt course measuring 21.097 km, which is a single loop. The start and finish are located at the G City Plejada Shopping Center in Bytom. Participants can count on nutrition and refreshment points as well as support from pacemakers, and after the race, there is an option to personalize the medal by engraving the result.
course_highlights: Single-loop half marathon course of 21.097 km with PZLA accreditation
100% asphalt surface with markings every 1 km
Nutrition and refreshment points along the route and a 3-hour time limit
additional: After the race, there is an option to personalize the medal with the result through engraving (cost 25 PLN). Pacemakers with balloons and special T-shirts are present on the route. The time limit to complete the half marathon is 3 hours; after this time, participants must stop and reach the finish line by minibus marked END OF THE HALF MARATHON. A group warm-up is scheduled for 9:45 AM. An active zone is prepared for children. The event attracts over 1200 participants annually, offering personalized medals, a 3-hour time limit, and activities for children. Registration is available online and at the race office.

name: PKO Wieczorny Półmaraton Łódź
description: PKO Evening Half Marathon Łódź is a new, atmospheric running event held in the center of Łódź. The start and finish are located at the revitalized EC1 combined heat and power plant, which is now a center of culture and science. The 21.097 km route takes runners through the most recognizable places in the city, combining industrial history with modernity. This race is not only about the result but also about the unique atmosphere and energy of the city.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the revitalized EC1 combined heat and power plant
Route passes through the most recognizable places in Łódź
Evening street race in the city center
additional: The participant limit is 5000 people. The start package includes a souvenir drawstring bag and a medal for everyone who completes the race. There is an option to purchase an official technical T-shirt by SMMASH. The participant limit is 5000, with discounts for PKO Bank Polski customers when paying online. Registrations began a week before the event. The route covers key points of Łódź.

name: 44 Strzeliński Rogaining
location: Wzgórza Strzelińskie, Strzelin, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Polskie Towarzystwo Turystyczno-Krajoznawcze Oddział Ziemi Strzelińskiej
description: Strzeliński Rogaining is a pedestrian orienteering rally organized by the Polish Tourist and Sightseeing Society, Ziemia Strzelińska Branch, since 1996. Teams of 2-5 people plan their own route, aiming within the allotted time to visit as many control points as possible, each with different point values, which requires navigation skills and strategy. The event is open to participants of various ages and skill levels, making it an attractive activity for enthusiasts and families alike. The event takes place in the picturesque terrain of the Strzelin Hills, offering opportunities for contact with nature and active recreation.
course_highlights: Terrain of the Strzelin Hills with diverse control points
Route of any length from about 5 km to 70 km, individually planned by teams
Use of map and compass for pedestrian navigation
additional: The competition is held in teams of 2-5 people, who independently plan and can modify their route during the race. Control points have different point values depending on the difficulty of finding them. The event is open to everyone, regardless of age and gender, with results divided into age and gender categories. The race includes various route lengths, from 6 to 70 km, with registration and route planning available before the start. The event takes place in the Strzelin Hills, surrounded by forests and terrain with varied topography.

name: Gontyniec Celtic Trail
location: Gontyniec, Chodzież, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Gontyniec Celtic Trail is a unique reverse-format race lasting 6 or 12 hours on loops of approximately 10 km in the picturesque Gontyńca massif. Participants cover as much distance as possible, benefiting from well-equipped refreshment stations after each loop. The route offers changing landscapes at different times of the day, with beautiful views of the Noteć Valley and unique natural and cultural attractions, such as figurative beehives shaped like ancient gods. This is a special experience for runners seeking challenges and unforgettable sensations.
course_highlights: Non-stop race on loops of about 10 km
Refreshment station after each loop for participants
Views of the Noteć Valley and unique figurative beehives along the route
additional: The race lasts 6 or 12 hours non-stop. The route runs on loops of about 10 km. A refreshment station is available after each loop. Participants can choose the 6- or 12-hour option. The route traverses the Gontyńca massif with scenic views and natural attractions. Trail, mountain, and forest paths, participant limit of 150 in each race, preparations from 8 to 20 weeks.

name: Run in Sopot IV - Opera Leśna
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Sopocie

description: Run in Sopot Opera Leśna is a 5 km race that will take place on September 19, 2026, in Sopot. The start and finish are located at the parking lot near Opera Leśna, and the route runs through scenic areas around this location. The race is part of a series of four events held at different dates and locations in Sopot, offering participants a unique atmosphere and the opportunity to compete over a short distance. The participant limit is 250 people, ensuring an intimate and well-organized event.
course_highlights: Route of 5 km around Opera Leśna in Sopot
Start and finish at the parking lot near Opera Leśna
Race takes place in a picturesque park and green areas

The event is part of the Grand Prix in cross-country running and Nordic walking marches, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle within the local community.
course_highlights: Cross-country routes in the picturesque terrain of Małkini Górna
Autumn scenery conducive to running and Nordic walking
Event as part of the Grand Prix in cross-country running and NW marches
additional: The event is part of the Grand Prix in cross-country running and Nordic walking marches organized by the Municipal Cultural and Sports Center in Małkini Górna. Registrations are conducted through the portal dostartu.pl. The organizer provides support and information at gokis@malkiniagorna.pl. Registration for the runs is available via the dostartu.pl platform. The race includes various distances, including options for children and youth.

name: Festiwal Biegowy JuraRun 2026
distance_verbose: 50 mil, 50 mil, Maraton, 23 km, Półmaraton, 12 km, 10 km, 5 km
description: The JuraRun Running Festival is a unique sporting event held in the heart of the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland, combining a passion for running, competition, and the satisfaction of pushing one's limits. In 2026, as many as 9 different running events are planned, including distances from 5 km to over 100 km, as well as Nordic Walking and night running. The routes lead through picturesque landscapes, limestone rocks, forests, and Jura hills, offering both technical challenges and beautiful views. The festival is open to runners of various skill levels, providing a rich accompanying program and attractive start packages.
course_highlights: Routes lead through forests, limestone rocks, and picturesque castles of the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland
JuraRun ULTRA 100+ is over 100 km ultra with minimal asphalt, requiring technique and endurance
On the JuraRun ULTRA 100+ route, among others, Góra Zborów (467 m above sea level) and the characteristic Rzędkowickie Rocks
additional: Starts are held in waves, including the JuraRun Night 10+ night run starting at 21:00. The start package includes, among other things, timing measurement, medical support, nutrition points, a medal, a recovery meal, and the option to purchase technical clothing with personalization. Ultra routes have mandatory equipment checked before the start. During the festival, animations, expo, and lectures on running and healthy lifestyle topics are organized. 9 sporting events, installment options, lectures and meetings on running and healthy living, and online registration are available.

name: Festiwal Biegowy Silesia Marathon 2026
description: Silesia Marathon is the largest running event in Silesia, which in 2026 will take place as a three-day running festival. Participants can choose from various distances, including the marathon, half marathon, ultramarathon, as well as 10 km and 5 km runs. The finish line is located at the iconic Silesian Stadium, adding a unique character to the event. It is not only a competition but also an unforgettable experience filled with emotions and a community atmosphere of runners.
course_highlights: Finish at the Silesian Stadium in Chorzów
Routes covering various distances: marathon, half marathon, ultramarathon, 10K, and 5K
Three-day running festival with many attractions
additional: In 2026, the Silesia Marathon will be held for the first time as a three-day running festival, offering more distances and options to choose a run suited to skills and goals. Participants receive a starter pack, including a free technical T-shirt when choosing the half marathon, marathon, or ultramarathon. Registration opens on December 15, 2025. The event includes various race categories, with regulations and routes available on the website. Participants can expect support and attractions throughout the event.

name: Baran Trail Race
location: Węgierska Górka, Żywiec County, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Baran Trail Race is a series of running events held in the picturesque Węgierska Górka. The race offers a variety of distances from 10 km to 100 km, taking place on challenging mountain routes with beautiful views and natural terrain. The event attracts both amateurs and experienced runners, providing unique challenges and atmosphere. Organizers ensure a professional course and participant safety.
course_highlights: Mountain routes of varying difficulty
Picturesque views of the Beskids
Natural, forested, and rocky terrain
additional: Start and finish in Węgierska Górka. The routes lead through the Beskids with diverse terrain. The event takes place on October 2-3, 2026. Four distances are available: 10 km, 25 km, 60 km, and 100 km. There are refreshment points along the course and medical support. The event offers different participant categories, as well as an archive of results and event partners.

name: ING Biegnij Warszawo
description: ING Run Warsaw is one of the most recognizable running events in Poland, attracting thousands of participants to the heart of the capital every year. The race takes place on the first Saturday of October and offers a 10-kilometer route through the most characteristic places of Warsaw. The FUNRUN formula emphasizes the joy of movement, without pressure or competition, encouraging running, walking, or jogging at your own pace. Along the route, participants are supported by music zones, cheerleaders, and motivating partner points, and each participant receives a commemorative Nike Dri-FIT shirt and a medal at the finish line.
course_highlights: 10 km route through the most atmospheric and characteristic places of Warsaw
Music zones and cheerleaders along the entire route
Hydration zone at the halfway point and comprehensive medical support
additional: The start package includes a Nike Dri-FIT shirt with a commemorative print, a start number with a chip for timing, gifts from partners, and a commemorative medal. Package pickup is available at Legia Sports Bar at Legia Warsaw Stadium from September 29 to October 3, 2026, with a recommendation for early collection. Drivers using catering services receive 2 hours of free parking. The route is certified by PZLA and is friendly for beginner runners. The event attracts over 6,000 participants, and the route has been changed to the right bank of the Vistula River, with significant involvement from ING employees and a charity collection.

name: XIII Podbieg na Makowicę
location: Rytro, Nowy Sącz County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 13th Makowica Ascent is a mountain race covering a distance of 10 km, scheduled to take place on October 3, 2026, in Rytro, Lesser Poland. The race route features a challenging profile with ascents, making it an excellent challenge for runners who enjoy mountain trails. Organizers encourage preparation with dedicated training plans tailored to various skill levels. The event is part of the TreningBiegacza.pl running calendar, which promotes running activity and supports runners in their preparations.
course_highlights: Mountain trail of 10 km
Challenging ascents on the route
Scenic views around Rytro
additional: Training plans are available from 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to the runner's VDOT level, with instructions and expert support. Organizers encourage using the TreningBiegacza.pl platform, which offers support in preparations and managing race information. The event focuses on trail running, and registration details have not yet been announced. The race is an opportunity to spend active time in the beautiful surroundings of Rytro.

name: 25 Poznań Maraton
description: The 25th Poznań Marathon named after Maciej Frankiewicz is a jubilee, 25th edition of the royal distance of 42.195 km, which will take place on October 4, 2026, in Poznań. The race has been attracting thousands of runners and spectators for a quarter of a century, offering a new, attractive route starting and ending at the International Fairgrounds in Poznań. Organizers ensure professional medical security, timing measurement, and a rich start package. This is a unique sports celebration with strong support from Poznań fans and a rich tradition.
course_highlights: New, attractive route starting and ending at the International Fairgrounds in Poznań
Royal marathon distance of 42.195 km
Jubilee, 25th edition with rich tradition and support from local fans
additional: The start package includes a bib with a chip, safety pins, sponsor materials, professional timing, medical security, nutrition points with isotonic drinks, water, chocolate, fruits, and sugar. The organizer provides free accommodation for 600 people in POSiR sports halls on October 3-4, 2026; participants must bring their own mats and sleeping bags. Numerous parking lots are available near MTP with various prices. Participants of the OK Poznań program receive a 25% discount, and seniors 60+ get a 50% reduction. An official marathon t-shirt can be ordered until September 1, 2026, for 70 PLN. Registration is open until October 1, 2026, with discounts for seniors and program participants, official gadgets and sportswear available, as well as accompanying events like Poznań Run Expo and Kids Marathon.

description: The Olsztyn Half Marathon is an annual race covering a half marathon distance (21.1 km) around the picturesque Ukiel Lake in Olsztyn. The course is mixed, including asphalt, cobblestone, hardened gravel paths, and forest trails, making it attractive and varied for runners. The event is accompanied by 5 km races and children's races, creating a sports atmosphere for the whole family. Organizers provide at least two refreshment zones along the route and professional race office support. It is an excellent opportunity to combine sport with the beauty of nature and active recreation.
course_highlights: Course length of 21.1 km around Ukiel Lake
Mixed surface: asphalt, cobblestone, gravel, forest trails
At least 2 refreshment zones along the route
additional: Start packages can be collected on 13.09.2025 from 14:00 to 20:00 and on race day from 8:00 to 10:45 at the race office at CRS UKIEL. Collection of packages is only in person. The time limit to complete the half marathon is 3 hours, and for the 5 km race 45 minutes. Registration on race day is not possible. The course is not certified by PZLA. The event includes various distances, including the half marathon, 5 km, relays, and the Family Mile. Participants can expect start packages, medals, finisher photos, insurance, and on-site attractions.

name: Wild Run
organizer: Fundacja Zoo Wrocław – DODO i Zoo Wrocław Sp. z o.o.

description: Wild Run is a charity run organized in Wrocław, with the route passing through the Wrocław Zoo area. The event aims to support the protection of endangered animal species living in Poland, and participants can also run virtually on any route. The main race consists of two loops of approximately 5 km each, and there are also runs for children and youth. All participants receive commemorative medals, and the top runners receive prizes from sponsors.
course_highlights: The main route is two loops of about 5 km each within Wrocław Zoo
Virtual run on any route, 10 km distance
Runs for children (100 m) and youth (about 1 km) with medals and prizes
additional: Start packages are issued on the race day from 12:00 to 15:30 at the zoo ticket offices. It is possible to order an extended package with a T-shirt, towel, or race bib belt. Participants of the main race are asked to return their race bibs, which will be used in subsequent editions. Shipping of start packages for the virtual race is carried out according to the registration deadline. The event includes various attractions, costume contests, support for animal protection, and the opportunity to participate in a virtual run. The run is part of activities promoting nature conservation and an active lifestyle.

name: XRUN Wielki Finał
location: Domu Zdrojowego CECHINI, Żegiestów-Zdrój, Małopolskie, Poland
description: The Grand Finale XRUN is a mountain trail run taking place on October 4, 2026, in Żegiestów-Zdrój, with the base at the CECHINI Spa House. Participants can choose from four distances: 40 km with an elevation gain of 1800 m, 28 km with 1300 m elevation gain, 18 km with 900 m elevation gain, and shorter distances for children. The routes pass through picturesque mountains, offering technical descents and challenging ascents, making the race attractive for mountain enthusiasts. The event is a perfect culmination of the running season, combining intensity with the beauty of mountain nature.
course_highlights: 40 km route with 1800 m elevation gain, start at 08:00, time limit 8 hours
28 km route with 1300 m elevation gain, start at 09:00, time limit 6 hours
18 km route with 900 m elevation gain, start at 09:30, time limit 4 hours
additional: Race office and start/finish for all distances at the CECHINI Spa House. Age categories for children from 3 to 15 years on distances of 150, 300, 500, 800, 1000 meters. Time limits for individual distances: 8h (40 km), 6h (28 km), 4h (18 km). The routes pass through Pusta Wielka, Jaworzynka, Bacówka PTTK near Wierchomla, and other mountain trails. Participants must be at least 16 years old (younger with written guardian consent). The event also includes family runs for kids and is the finale of the mountain running series in Poland, ending the season at the highest sporting and community level.
