description: The 15th Legnica Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Legnica, attracting runners from various parts of Poland. The half marathon course runs through the picturesque streets of the city, offering participants the opportunity to test their endurance and enjoy a sporting atmosphere. The event is organized by the Sports and Recreation Center in Legnica, which ensures professional organization and participant safety. It is an excellent opportunity to spend active time and connect with the running community.
course_highlights: The course runs through the center of Legnica and surrounding streets
Flat profile of the route conducive to achieving good results
Picturesque city views and a sporting atmosphere
additional: The starter package includes a race number, a timing chip, and a commemorative medal. There are nutrition and medical points along the route. After the race, a refreshment is organized for participants. The participant limit is set, and registrations are conducted online. Registration for the race is on October 4, 2026, in Legnica, with various distances available. The event is promoted on Facebook.

name: II Korczyński Półmaraton Górski XI Korczyński Bieg i Nordic Walking "Do Prządek"
description: The 2nd Korczyński Mountain Half Marathon and the 11th Korczyńskie Races and Nordic Walking "To Prządek" is a sporting event taking place in the picturesque areas of Korczyna and Czarnorzek. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, engaging both experienced runners and amateurs of Nordic walking. The routes lead through mountain trails, offering participants contact with nature and terrain challenges. Registrations are conducted electronically, and the organizers ensure a good atmosphere and safety for the competitors.
course_highlights: Mountain routes around Korczyna and Czarnorzek
Scenic landscapes and natural trails
Routes suitable for runners and Nordic walking
additional: Registrations are conducted electronically via the TIMEKEEPER platform. The event will take place on October 10, 2026, in Czarnorzeki. The regulations are available for download on the organizer's website. The event includes a half marathon, a race, and Nordic walking, with the possibility of online registration. The date of the event is October 10, 2026.

name: 30 Bieg Przełajowy o Nóż Komandosa
location: Stadion miejski, Lubliniec, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 30th Commando Knife Cross Country Run is a prestigious running event organized under the honorary patronage of Bishop of the Polish Armed Forces, Dr. Wiesław Lechowicz. The race takes place at the Municipal Stadium in Lubliniec and is dedicated to soldiers and uniformed service officers who compete in full field uniform. The event aims to identify the top uniformed services runners in cross country, promote mass running events, and foster integration within uniformed communities. The course runs along the street in front of the stadium to the finish line on the stadium track, with the start at 12:00 for women and 12:27 for men.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Lubliniec
Course runs along the street in front of the stadium and finishes on the stadium track
Race in full field uniform and special tactical shoes
additional: All participants compete in the OPEN category without age group divisions. Full field uniform with long sleeves and special tactical shoes above ankle height in military colors are required. Additional civilian elements are only allowed if they match the uniform's colors. Approval is at the discretion of the race judge. Participants must be soldiers or officers of uniformed services, either on active duty or reserve. Cross-country terrain, online registration, participant limit until 09/15/2026, entry fees from 150 PLN to 200 PLN, start at 12:00 at the Municipal Stadium in Lubliniec.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The 17th Mysłowice Grand Prix is a series of races organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, combining a passion for running with an active lifestyle. The event promotes health, integration, and joy of movement, inviting runners of various skill levels and ages. The races take place in the picturesque areas of Mysłowice, creating a friendly atmosphere and a running community. Participants can compete in running, Nordic walking, and canicross, and participation in the Grand Prix is free of charge.
course_highlights: Trails run through the forest above Bolina
Various competitions: running, Nordic walking, canicross
Picturesque areas of Mysłowice conducive to recreation and competition
additional: Registrations for the Grand Prix series are only possible at the Race Office on the day of the race. Participation in the events is free. The event attracts competitors from different cities and clubs, with women making up over 27%. Organizers ensure proper organization and support the integration of runners. The event includes various dates in 2026, focusing on community and promoting an active lifestyle.

name: 12. PKO Cracovia Półmaraton Królewski
description: The Cracovia Royal Half Marathon is an international half marathon held in Kraków, a city with a thousand-year tradition and former residence of Polish kings. The race attracts thousands of participants from around the world, combining sporting passion with sightseeing of historic sites. The finish line at the impressive TAURON Arena Kraków provides unforgettable emotions and the cheers of spectators. The event is part of the Royal Running Trilogy and the Polish Half Marathon Crown, highlighting its prestige and importance among runners.
course_highlights: The route runs through the streets of Kraków, a city rich in history and royal heritage
Finish at the largest entertainment and sports hall in Poland - TAURON Arena Kraków
The race is part of the prestigious Royal Running Trilogy and the Polish Half Marathon Crown
additional: Race packets are collected at designated points in accordance with the Run with Class principles. In 2026, the race is part of the Royal Running Trilogy, where participants can earn special medals and a trophy for completing all three events in the series. The event includes various race categories, including the half marathon and other distances, with online registration and registration at the race office. The race takes place in the city area, with routes leading through attractive locations in Kraków.

name: Wzgórzowa Trzynastka
location: Chrząszczyce, Opole County, Opole Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Hilltop Thirteen is a cross-country race covering a distance of 13 km, held in the picturesque area of Chrząszczyce. The route goes along municipal roads and through a military training ground between the towns of Chrząszczyce, Domecko, Opole-Winów, and Górki. The event promotes a healthy and active lifestyle and popularizes running as a form of recreation. In addition to the individual race, relay competitions, a category for uniformed services, and family orienteering teams are organized. The start and race office are located in Chrząszczyce, and the participant limit is 300 people.
course_highlights: The route passes through a military training ground and municipal roads
Picturesque surroundings of Chrząszczyce, Domecko, Opole-Winów, and Górki
Time limit of 120 minutes to complete 13 km
additional: Participant limit: 300 people. Start and race office in Chrząszczyce at ul. Szkolna 3, open on race day from 10:00 to 13:00. Technical running shirts can be ordered until September 28, to be collected with the race kit. Individuals over 16 years old can participate; those under 18 require written parental consent. Cross-country race, relays, outdoor game for children, fundraising for the stadium.

description: Piwna Mila is a unique race with an adjustable distance from 1700 to 2000 meters, and is the most important event on the third day of the Sun Festival in Wąsowo. Participants start by drinking a beer, and approximately every 500 meters there are refreshment points with beer. This sporting celebration combines runners, spectators, and entire families, offering a unique atmosphere and a special medal for completing the race.
course_highlights: Flexible distance 1700 - 2000 m
Refreshment points with beer every 500 m
Race start by drinking a beer
additional: The start package includes a bib with a chip for timing and 4 craft beers along the route. The bib must be worn on the front of the outfit and cannot be covered or modified. A T-shirt can be ordered during the registration fee payment in the Runner's Panel. The race office is open on 14.08.2026 (17:00 - 19:00), 15.08.2026 (7:00 - 11:00), and 16.08.2026 (11:00 - 11:45). The flexible distance is 1700-2000 meters, beer on the route, online registration from January 1, 2026, to August 12, 2026, with the option to order a T-shirt during the registration fee payment.

name: UltraKotlina
location: Szklarska Poręba, Jelenia Góra County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: UltraKotlina is a mountain ultramarathon held in the Jelenia Góra Valley, covering scenic ranges of Rudawy Janowickie, Gór Kaczawskich, Izerskie, and Karkonosze. The event offers six distances from 15 km to 142 km and a relay race, with the finish line in Szklarska Poręba. The routes are marked and lead through well-known trails and peaceful off-road paths, allowing both experienced ultramarathon runners and beginners to enjoy every kilometer. The event is also an opportunity to bring the running community together and promote the region.
course_highlights: Routes pass through four mountain ranges: Rudawy Janowickie, Gór Kaczawskie, Izerskie, and Karkonosze
Route marked with white tape with reflectors, chalk spray, and directional signs
Scenic views and the opportunity to admire the Jelenia Góra Valley from various points
additional: The start package can be collected at the event base or just before the start. The organizer provides buses to the start from the finish line. The route is marked with tape with reflectors, chalk spray, and signs. The race office operates at different locations and times from October 9 to 11. The time limit for individual distances ranges from 3 to 30 hours. Route verification takes place at control points, where participants must confirm their start number. Distances include ultramarathons and trail running, with mountain and technical control points, and the event is scheduled for October 2026.

name: XIV Biegi Przyjaźni
description: Friendship Run is one of the events within the Kaszuby Biegają series, the largest running event in northern Poland. The race takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Skrzeszewo, offering participants the opportunity to spend active time and discover the charms of Kaszuby. The running series attracts runners of various ages and skill levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the integration of the local community.
course_highlights: The route runs through scenic areas of Kaszuby
The race takes place in a natural, friendly environment
The event is part of the Kaszuby Biegają series, the largest running event in northern Poland
additional: The event will take place on October 11, 2026, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the local community. Participants can expect a medal, prizes, raffles, and refreshments.

name: Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail
description: Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail is a series of trail running events held on hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia with the event base at KJ Barłomino. The event offers five distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km, and 11 km, providing a variety of challenges for trail runners. The race promotes the beauty of Kashubian landscapes and regional attractions, and participants can enjoy excellent refreshment stations along the route. The event is supported by the #ActiveVillage program and organized by the Pomerania Sports Association.
course_highlights: Hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia
Beautiful Kashubian landscapes
Excellent refreshment stations along the route
additional: The event offers five distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km, 11 km, and a Junior Trail run up to 1 km. The races take place at KJ Barłomino. The event promotes regional trails and tourist attractions of Pomerania and is supported by the #ActiveVillage program. Supported by Coconaut, with routes of varying difficulty levels, an attractive base in Barłomino, and stunning views of Kashubia.

name: Łemkowyna Trail
location: Krynica-Zdrój, Powiat nowotarski, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
distance_verbose: Ultramaraton, 100 km, Ultramaraton, 50 km, Maraton, 28 km, 10 km
description: The Lemkowyna Trail is a mountain run along the route marked by the Main Beskid Trail in the Low Beskids. The event takes place around Krynica-Zdrój and Komańcza, offering various distances from 10 km to the 150 km ultramarathon. The route features significant elevation gain and natural, demanding terrain, making it a challenge for trail and mountain adventure enthusiasts. The event has a strong tradition and attracts runners from all over Poland and abroad.
course_highlights: Route marked by the Main Beskid Trail
Significant elevation gains up to +5860 m and -5970 m on the longest distance
Diverse distances from 10 km to 150 km, with time limits
additional: Registration can be transferred between routes until October 1, 2026. Participant limit for each distance ranges from 300 to 550 people. Starts are scheduled for October 17 and 18, 2026, with different times for each distance. Each distance has a time limit. The race takes place on natural mountain trails with substantial elevation gain. The courses include elevation gains reaching up to 740 m for the 30 km and 150 km ultramarathon, with time limits up to 35 hours. Online registration is available, with options for fee refunds and transfer of start packages.

name: Pomerania Ultra-Trail®
description: Pomerania Ultra-Trail® is a series of trail running events held on hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia, based at KJ Barłomino. The event offers five distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km, and 11 km, providing a variety of challenges for trail runners. The races promote the beauty of Kashubian landscapes and regional attractions, with well-prepared aid stations along the route. The event is supported by the #ActiveVillage program and organized by the Pomerania Sports Association.
course_highlights: Hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia
Beautiful Kashubian landscapes
Well-stocked aid stations along the route
additional: The event takes place at KJ Barłomino. There are 5 main distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km, 11 km, as well as a Junior run up to 1 km. The organizer is the Pomerania Sports Association. The event promotes long-distance trail running and Nordic Walking. It is supported by the #ActiveVillage program. The event features multiple distances, routes through beautiful Kashubian areas, support from #ActiveVillage, and a base at KJ Barłomino.

name: Dębowiec Nocna Pętla
description: Dębowiec Night Loop is a mountain run on the Dębowiec slope in Bielsko-Biała, taking place on an 8-kilometer route through forest trails from Dębowiec to Wapienica Valley and back. Participants must conquer an intense uphill climb to the Dębowiec cable car station, and at the finish line, there will be a bonfire and a meal. The run is a unique opportunity to actively spend an October evening, and participants receive a start package, medals, and prizes for the best and oldest competitors. Simultaneously, a Nordic Walking march of approximately 4 km takes place, also ending at the Dębowiec Shelter 520.
course_highlights: 8 km route through forest trails from Dębowiec to Wapienica Valley and back
Intense uphill climb to the Dębowiec cable car station
Finish at Dębowiec Shelter 520 with a bonfire and meal
additional: Participants must have a headlamp. Prizes in the form of sports equipment vouchers will be awarded to the top three in the Open categories and the top three women. Special awards are planned for the oldest male and female participants. After the run, a bonfire is organized at Dębowiec Shelter 520. A free Nordic Walking march of approximately 4 km takes place simultaneously, starting at 18:00 from the lower station of the cable car on Dębowiec. The race route includes starting at the lower station of the cable car on Dębowiec, an uphill to the clearing, a turnaround 'pin' at the control point, and finishing at Dębowiec Shelter 520. The Nordic Walking route is 6 km, passing through Dylówki Pass and Cyberniok. Participants need a headlamp.

name: IV Wilczy Półmaraton
price_range: 100 zł - 130 zł za dystans, 80 zł za koszulkę
description: The 4th Wolf Half Marathon is a unique trail run held in the picturesque, wild forests of Rybnik Forest District, in the "Głębokie Doły" nature reserve. The half marathon route, approximately 22 km long, runs through unique forest paths, offering runners contact with nature and rare plant species. It is the only such half marathon in Silesia, guaranteeing a large dose of adrenaline and satisfaction for cross-country enthusiasts. Each participant receives a commemorative medal, and the course features amusing, muddy traps. We invite you to Wilczy for an unforgettable sporting experience!
course_highlights: Route approximately 22 km through the forests of Rybnik Forest District
Forest paths of the "Głębokie Doły" nature reserve with a unique microclimate
Natural muddy traps and wild, scenic terrains
additional: Commemorative medal for every participant. Dogs are welcome. The race office is located at the Cultural Center in Wilczy, Karola Miarki 123. A commemorative T-shirt is available optionally for 80 PLN. The route is approximately 22 km, forest terrain, participation options include canicross and Nordic Walking, commemorative medals, online registration with prices depending on the date.

name: MnO Jaszczur - Bludny Balvan
description: MnO Jaszczur - Bludny Balvan is a 10 km race that will take place on October 17, 2026, in Opole. The event is a great opportunity to test your form over a medium distance, and participants can benefit from training plans tailored to various levels of advancement. The event is aimed at runners seeking a challenge and the opportunity to optimally prepare for the start under the guidance of experts.
course_highlights: 10 km distance
Street route in Opole
Ability to prepare with training plans from 8 to 20 weeks
additional: Training plans from 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner's VDOT level, with detailed instructions and expert support. Information about training and preparatory plans, event included in the outdoor activity calendar for 2026.

name: Rajd Waligóry
description: Waligóra Rally is an orienteering rally held in the picturesque areas of Pogórze Wiśnickie near Bochnia. Participants compete by finding control points using a map and compass, combining adventure, movement, and fun outdoors. The routes vary in length and difficulty, suitable for both families and more experienced competitors. The event is recreational and sports-oriented, promoting an active lifestyle and exploring local nature and history.
course_highlights: Routes lead through Pogórze Wiśnickie with charming forest paths and hills
Control points marked with white-orange lanterns with punchers
Ability to independently plan the route and choose the order of visiting points
additional: The start and finish of the rally are located at Arka Cafe in Lanckorona (for the Mini Waligóra Rally). Participants receive a map before the start and can plan their route and start time individually within designated hours. The rally takes place without an official ending and awards ceremony, and results are published on the website. GPS navigation is prohibited in the terrain; a compass is allowed. Terrain orientation, control points, maps, no GPS navigation.

name: 12. PKO Półmaraton Gliwicki
description: The Gliwice Half Marathon is a running event organized since 2014, which over 12 years has become an important point on the map of Polish running events. The race takes place on a route starting and ending at the PreZero Arena Sports and Entertainment Hall in Gliwice. Participants can expect professional organization, a time limit for completing the course, and support from volunteers and city services. In 2026, the race will conclude, and the organization will be taken over by the city of Gliwice, continuing the tradition of this event.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the PreZero Arena Sports and Entertainment Hall in Gliwice
Half marathon route through the streets of Gliwice
Time limit for completing the course: 3 hours
additional: Race office open at the PreZero Arena Sports and Entertainment Hall in Gliwice on Saturday, October 25, 2025, from 14:00 to 20:00 and on Sunday, October 26, 2025, from 7:00 to 8:00. The time limit for completing the half marathon is 3 hours from the start. Registration for the event is open, with discount options for participants. The event supports the local community and promotes an active lifestyle.

name: 52.Maraton Dębno 2026
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Dębnie
description: The 52nd Dębno Marathon is the oldest and one of the fastest marathons in Poland, taking place on October 18, 2026. The route, 42.195 km long and certified by PZLA, runs through the streets of Dębno and its surroundings, conducive to achieving personal bests. The event has a rich tradition dating back to 1966 and attracts both amateurs and professional runners from Poland and abroad. Participants can expect professional organization, numerous refreshment points, and enthusiastic support from spectators. The marathon is also an opportunity for the running community to come together and a sports celebration for entire families.
course_highlights: 42.195 km route with PZLA certification
4 laps - two on the Dębno-Dargomyśl-Cychry-Dębno route and two through the streets of Dębno
Asphalt surface (98%) and cobblestone (2%)
additional: The race starts at J. Słowacki Street in Dębno. The route has timing points every 5 km. The race office is located at the Sports and Rehabilitation Hall at Piłsudskiego 10. The event includes accompanying activities such as concerts and a mass for marathon runners. The marathon is part of the "Eagle Running" series. Registration is online, and the event also features races of various distances, support along the route, and attractions for participants.

name: Wartko!... bez Gaszowice
organizer: Ośrodek Kultury i Sportu w Gaszowicach
description: WARTKO!... Gaszowice Run is an annual street race over a distance of 10 km organized by the Cultural and Sports Center in Gaszowice. The event attracts enthusiasts of active recreation and promotes a sporty lifestyle within the local community. The race takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Gaszowice, offering participants the opportunity for competition and shared fun. The event is open and friendly to runners of various skill levels.
course_highlights: Street race over a distance of 10 km
The route runs through scenic areas of Gaszowice
A sports event with a local and community-building character
additional: Start packages are collected at the event office. The event has an integrative character and is held as part of local sports celebrations. The organizer provides electronic timing measurement. The event is open to runners of all ages and skill levels. It is family-friendly, featuring medals, start packages, and traditional food at the finish line. Participants over 70 years old can participate free of charge in the main race and Nordic Walking march.

organizer: Akademia Wychowania Fizycznego im. Jerzego Kukuczki w Katowicach

description: The 14th Panewnicki Wild Run is a recreational running and Nordic Walking event held in the picturesque Panewnicki forests in Katowice. The competition takes place on a loop approximately 4,882 meters long, which can be completed up to four times, with a time limit of 3 hours. The event promotes an active lifestyle and education about proper behavior in forest areas. Participants can compete individually or in pairs, and the event is open to both amateurs and athletes affiliated with sports clubs.
course_highlights: Trail in the Panewnicki forests approximately 4,882 meters long
Loop marked every 1 km
Ability to complete the course up to 4 times
additional: The time limit to complete the course is 3 hours. Participants over 18 must sign a declaration of participation at their own risk or present a medical certificate. Minors must be accompanied by a parent or guardian during verification. Starting fees are non-refundable but can be transferred to the next race if registered by Thursday before the race at 3:00 PM. The competition is open to amateurs and clubs, with the option to purchase annual packages. The course is approximately 4,882 meters long, and the time limit is 3 hours.

name: XVII Półmaraton Ziemi Puckiej
location: Stadion Miejski w Pucku, Puck, Puck County, Poland
description: The 17th Puck Land Half Marathon is a well-known Pomeranian running event, returning in 2026 in a new edition under the banner of STONE TRI & RUN. The race takes place on a refreshed route in an autumn setting, making it an ideal end to the running season. The event features races over the half marathon distance and 5 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic walking march, all with individual start times. It is a perfect opportunity to actively spend time in the beautiful Kashubian landscapes and experience the sporting atmosphere of the Puck Triathlon Series.
course_highlights: Refreshed half marathon route through picturesque Kashubian landscapes
Autumn climate conducive to runners
Final event in the Puck Triathlon Series
additional: The event includes three competitions: a half marathon, a 5 km run, and a 5 km Nordic walking march, all with individual starts. Organizers ensure professional route preparation, excellent marking, and security. The event is part of the STONE TRI & RUN cycle, which promotes an active lifestyle and a family-friendly sporting atmosphere in Kashubia. The route is asphalt, with start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Puck, the finale of the Puck Triathlon Series. Registrations open from December 12, 2025, to October 12, 2026.

name: 16 Nocna Ściema
description: Night Deception is a unique night marathon and half-marathon held in Koszalin, known for its excellent atmosphere and distinctive nocturnal setting. The race course consists of a loop approximately 7 kilometers long, which participants complete multiple times depending on the chosen distance. The race has an official PZLA certification, ensuring the verification of the course length and the possibility of setting world records. This is the sixteenth edition of the event, attracting runners eager to improve their personal bests in the unforgettable conditions of a night run.
course_highlights: The course consists of a loop about 7 km long, completed 3 or 6 times
Official PZLA certification confirming the course length
Views of the stadium along the route and the hilly terrain of Koszalin
additional: The registration office for children and youth opens around 7:00 PM, with a limited number of 20 spots. The registration office for adults is located at the Koszalin University of Technology Sports Hall at Racławicka Street, about 300 meters from the stadium, and is open until 30 minutes before the start. A photo ID is required to collect the race number. The race route runs through the streets of Koszalin with views of the aviation museum exhibits. Medals and gadgets are updated annually and are an important part of the event. The event offers various distances, including marathon and half-marathon, with live reports, photo galleries, and videos, as well as online and in-person registration options. Participants can look forward to attractive prizes and the opportunity to compete in different thematic categories.

name: Chwałowicki Maraton Napoleoński
organizer: Stowarzyszenie na rzecz Rozwoju i Integracji Chwałowic, Arka Tołłoczko, Rafał Malitkowski
description: The Chwałowicki Napoleonic Marathon is an intimate marathon race held in the picturesque village of Chwałowice, located among forests and fields. The 42.195 km route runs through forest and rural roads, in a peaceful atmosphere without crowds, with signage and convenient access. The event is organized by local runners who emphasize a friendly atmosphere and recreational character of the race, rather than competition and prizes. It is an excellent option for cross-country running enthusiasts in a natural environment.
course_highlights: Route of 42.195 km running through forest and rural roads
Start and finish on Polna Street in Chwałowice
Signage every kilometer and convenient parking spots
additional: No crowds and a relaxed atmosphere without competition pressure. The route is marked and laid out by the Harcownik Running Club. Possibility to participate in a cycle of 4 marathons per year on the same route. The event has a friendly and recreational character. Napoleonic Marathon, mainly urban park terrain, training preparations, online registration, various distances, sign-ups, regulations, GPX routes.

name: Sopot Półmaraton
description: Sopot Half Marathon is an annual race covering the half marathon distance, held in the picturesque seaside city of Sopot. Participants have the opportunity to run through charming parts of the city, with the finish line at ERGO Arena, providing a unique atmosphere and comfort. The event attracts runners from all over Poland, offering professional organization and attractive starting packages. It is an excellent opportunity to experience sports emotions in the Pearl of the Baltic and to receive a commemorative medal and T-shirt.
course_highlights: The route runs through the center of Sopot and seaside promenades
Finish line located at ERGO Arena
Picturesque views of the Baltic Sea and the characteristic Sopot pier
additional: The start package includes an official T-shirt and medal. The half marathon route is certified and runs through the center of Sopot and seaside promenades. The finish line is at ERGO Arena, ensuring comfortable conditions for competitors after the race. Start packages are available from February 10, 2026, with a participant limit of 3,500 people, discounts for Sopot Card holders, and the event is part of the Pomorze Half Marathons Crown cycle 2026-2030.

name: XIV Bieg Nadwiślański Szlakiem Doliny D... (Tczew)
price_range: Półmaraton: od 50 PLN do 180 PLN, Maraton: od 60 PLN do 220 PLN
description: The 14th Vistula River Valley Run along the Lower Vistula Valley is an annual race held in Tczew County. Participants can choose between two routes: a marathon of 42.195 km with PZLA certification and a half marathon of 21.097 km without certification. The courses lead through picturesque areas of the Vistula Valley, with varied surfaces including asphalt and gravel, and the race takes place with limited vehicle traffic. The marathon starts in Tczew at 9:00 AM, and the half marathon begins in Małe Walichnawy at 11:00 AM, with the finish line located in Tczew.
course_highlights: Marathon with PZLA certification of 42.195 km through Tczew and surrounding towns
Half marathon of 21.097 km with a mixed asphalt and gravel route
Course marked every 1 km with horizontal signs and yellow boards
additional: The participant limit is 400 paid runners. The start line closes 15 minutes after the race begins. The marathon route is PZLA certified, the half marathon is not certified. The finish line is at the Building and Clothing Schools Complex in Tczew, ul. Bałdowska 19. The routes feature varied surfaces, limited participant registration to 400, online registration available, the event includes both half marathon and marathon.

name: XLIV Perła Paprocan
description: Perła Paprocan Run is a unique marathon around Lake Paprocany in Tychy, combining competition with training on almost any distance. Participants can run one or multiple laps of the 7-kilometer loop, up to the full marathon distance. The run is recreational and integrative, promoting a healthy lifestyle and a good atmosphere among runners. Tychy is the only city in Poland where the marathon takes place twice a year, and Perła Paprocan is one of these editions.
course_highlights: Route around Lake Paprocany with a length of 7 km per lap
Surface made of cobblestones (over 50%) and paved paths and forest trails
A station with drinks, fruits, and sweets available after each lap
additional: Start and finish at the Recreation Center Paprocany, ul. Parkowa 17, Tychy. Race numbers can be collected on the days preceding the run and on the day of the event. The participant limit is 1111. Runners do not need to declare their distance before the race and can change it during the event. Participants from 12 years of age are allowed with written parental/guardian consent. Valuable items can be left in a deposit. The run is recreational, and the rule of running on half of the paths applies to allow overtaking. Participation from 12 years old with guardian consent, stations with drinks and fruits, participant limit 1111, online registration, organized twice a year.

name: XVI Półmaraton Szakala Dookoła Lasu Łagi... (Łódź)
description: Autumn Szakal Festival is a two-day running event in Łagiewnicki Forest in Łódź, combining various trail distances. The XVI Szakal Half Marathon features a classic, demanding route with scenic ponds and steep ascents, ideal for runners seeking a challenge and contact with nature. The program also includes Ultra Szakal, Cross Szakal, and races for children, making the festival attractive to a wide range of participants. Organizers ensure a good atmosphere and safety, and the course allows for competition or a leisurely enjoyment of the autumn forest.
course_highlights: The half marathon course runs through scenic ponds and steep ascents of Łagiewnicki Forest
Ultra Szakal is approximately 52 km long, featuring a historic water mill and the Snail Hill
Cross Szakal is a demanding but accessible 7.8 km trail distance
additional: Start groups are divided by gender and half marathon results: women start at 12:00, men in two groups at 12:15 and 12:25. Participants with a record below 1:28:00 can start in group M I if packages are available. Race packages are issued at the Race Office according to the start number. The event includes various distances and locations for pick-up of race kits, requiring proof of identity. The race takes place in a forest setting, making it a unique experience for nature lovers and trail runners.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
price_range: wstęp wolny, wymagana wcześniejsza rejestracja i opłata startowa
description: 146th Gliwice Park Run Provocation is an annual running event held in the city park of Gliwice. The event combines sport, a good atmosphere, and contact with nature, offering activities for both experienced runners and those looking to spend time without the pressure of competition. The race traditionally starts on the clearing behind Piast Stadium, and the race office opens at 9:00 AM. It is an excellent opportunity to actively end February and enter the upcoming spring season with new energy.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the city park of Gliwice
Start on the clearing behind Piast Stadium (entrance from Leśna Street)
The route is suitable for both experienced runners and amateurs
additional: Race office open from 9:00 AM. Prior registration and an entry fee are required to be classified. The event takes place in urban greenery, promoting integration and recreation. The race will be held on October 31, 2026, with the start on the clearing behind Piast Stadium, and online registration is available.

description: The Gorlicki Mountain Run is an annual running event held in the picturesque surroundings of Radocyna and Magura Małastowska in the Low Beskids. The competition offers three distances: 7.6 km, 23.9 km, and a Vertical run of 2.3 km with significant elevation gain. The race attracts both amateurs and elite runners, providing a unique atmosphere and cash prizes. The participant limit is 400 people, with start and finish located at the State Forests OSW "Radocyna" and Magura Ski Park. This is the eleventh edition of this event, which combines sporting competition with the beauty of mountain nature.
course_highlights: 24 km route with 610 m elevation gain
7 km route with 160 m elevation gain
Vertical 2.3 km with 340 m elevation gain to Magura Małastowska
additional: Participant limit: 400 people (150 for 7 km, 250 for 24 km). Start and finish at the State Forests OSW "Radocyna". The race office is open from 7:45 to 10:00. The time limit for the 24 km is 5 hours. Participants must have race numbers attached to the front of their shirts or shorts. Individuals with a Rate My Trail ranking of 730 points or higher start free of charge. The routes include mountain trails with muddy sections, and the start is scheduled for 10:30. The event attracts both amateurs and experienced trail runners.

name: Marceliński Bieg Jesienny 2026
description: Marceliński Autumn Run 2026 is a cross-country race organized in Poznań by running enthusiasts from the Biegi.Wlkp. group. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the aesthetic qualities of the location. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on popularizing cross-country running in Greater Poland, offering participants a unique running experience in beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Cross-country race on scenic routes in Poznań
Routes highlighting the aesthetic qualities of the location
Organized by experienced running enthusiasts from Greater Poland
additional: The race route is available on Garmin Connect. Participants can pick up their race kit with an authorization form. Cross-country event held in Lasek Marceliński, November 8, 2026. Medals in the form of puzzles. Forest routes.

name: 14. PKO Bieg Niepodległości w Rzeszowie
description: The 14th PKO Independence Run in Rzeszów is an annual running event organized by the Rzeszów Running Club "Rzeszów Biega" in partnership with the Rzeszów City Hall and PKO Bank Polski. The main race on a 10 km distance starts and finishes at the Rzeszów Market Square, taking place on November 11th at 11:11 AM. The event promotes an active lifestyle and running in the Podkarpacie region, offering age classifications and special categories, including categories for doctors and lawyers. Participants receive a race kit with a T-shirt, number, and chip, and a commemorative medal at the finish line. The participant limit is 3000 people, and participation requires confirmation of fitness to run through a medical certificate or declaration.
course_highlights: Main race on a 10 km distance with start and finish at Rzeszów Market Square
Separate age classifications and special categories (e.g., doctors, lawyers)
Participant limit of 3000 people, race kit includes a T-shirt, number, and chip
additional: Gilding on the medal is available for an additional fee of 30 PLN. On race day, the number of race kits is limited, and the registration fee is non-refundable. Participants must be over 16 years old (minors with guardian consent). Race kits include a T-shirt, race number, and chip. The route is marked every 1 km, and the event features warm-up sessions and refreshment points along the course. Wearing the organizer's mandatory T-shirt is required.

name: 36. Bieg Niepodległości w Warszawie
description: The 35th Independence Run in Warsaw is an annual running event organized on the occasion of National Independence Day. The main 10 km race takes place on the streets of the capital city, with start and finish lines located on Aleja Jana Pawła II. The event attracts both experienced runners and amateurs, offering also a Nordic walking category and a commemorative mile race over 1918 meters. The main race starts in waves, ensuring comfort and safety for participants. Organizers provide a rich program and efficient service, including the collection of race numbers at convenient times before the race.
course_highlights: Certified route by PZLA measuring 10 km through Warsaw streets
Start and finish on Aleja Jana Pawła II, at ul. Miła
Wave start of the main race divided into zones based on expected times
additional: The main race starts at 11:11 with a wave division into time zones. The Independence Mile begins at 10:00. Participants in active wheelchair, handbike, and tandem categories start at 11:08. Race numbers can be collected at Westfield Arkadia from November 7 to 10; on race day, the race office is closed (except for packet pickup for participants from outside Warsaw between 8:00 and 10:00). Participants are asked to line up at the start in white or red shirts, forming a white-red flag. The route is well-known and loved, with about 20,000 participants taking part. The event includes various categories such as the main race, Nordic walking, and virtual options available until November 17. In previous years, it was the most numerous running event in Poland.

name: Poznański Bieg Niepodległości – Kocham Polskę!
location: Strzeszyn, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
price_range: 20 zł za koszulkę techniczną, wpisowe na stronie nie jest wyraźnie podane
description: Poznański Bieg Niepodległości - Kocham Polskę! is cross-country race organized in picturesque locations in Poznań, especially at Strzeszyn near Malibu Beach. The event is part of activities by a group of running enthusiasts who have been promoting cross-country running in Greater Poland since 2014, emphasizing the aesthetics of the routes and the sporting character of the event. The race has a patriotic dimension, taking place on November 11, combining sport with honoring Poland's independence. We invite runners to participate in various distances in beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Cross-country route around Strzeszyn and Malibu Beach
Picturesque green areas of Poznań
Patriotic race organized on November 11
additional: The organizer is a group of running enthusiasts from Greater Poland, active since 2014, specializing in cross-country races. The race takes place on green areas of Strzeszyn, near Malibu Beach. The event has a patriotic character and is part of the Poznań Running Trilogy. Participant limit is 750, with scenic routes and cross-country races.

name: 10 Bieg Niepodległości z wąsem
location: Stadion Olimpijski, Wrocław, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Wrocław Independence Run with a mustache is an annual running event organized at the Olympic Stadium in Wrocław, commemorating the 107th anniversary of Poland regaining independence. Participants can choose between a 10 km or 5 km distance, and the main race route is certified by PZLA. The race takes place on closed roads, and at the finish line, runners receive a medal and a recovery meal. Free accompanying runs are organized for children, and participants can purchase a high-quality technical T-shirt with the race logo.
course_highlights: 10 km route certified by PZLA, consisting of two 5 km loops
Start and finish at the Pergola of the Olympic Stadium
Route runs on asphalt and gravel roads at the foot of flood embankments
additional: Race kits are issued at the event office at the Olympic Stadium on November 10 and 11. The kit includes a start number, mustache socks, a stick-on mustache, sponsor products, a calendar, a T-shirt (if ordered), a medal, and a recovery meal. There is a hydration point along the route. The race is held on roads closed to traffic. Free accompanying runs for children are organized. Technical T-shirts can be ordered until October 16, 2025, for 90 PLN. Changing rooms and deposit facilities are available on site. The 5 km race starts at 10:11, and the 10 km race at 11:11. The race takes place on closed roads, with accompanying runs for children, the option to purchase a T-shirt during registration on DataSport, medals for participants, and registration on the day of the event.

name: 9 Olsztyński Bieg Niepodległości
location: Centrum Rekreacyjno-Sportowe Ukiel, Olsztyn, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Olsztyn Independence Run is an annual patriotic sporting event held in Olsztyn, combining the joy of running with the celebration of Independence Day. The event is open to everyone, from experienced runners to families with children. The races take place at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Center and include 5 km and 10 km runs, Nordic walking marches, and short children's races up to 400 meters. The atmosphere is lively despite the autumn weather, and the number of spots is limited, with online registration open until November 6th.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km race routes run through the Ukiel CRS area and nearby streets: Sielska, Schumana, and Kapitańska
The event combines athletic competition with patriotic celebration
Nordic walking marches and children's races up to 400 meters are also available
additional: Start and finish are located at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Center. The event takes place on November 11th, with online registration open until November 6th. Participants can choose from 5 km and 10 km runs, Nordic walking marches, and children's races up to 400 meters. Due to the race, traffic disruptions are expected on the route. Road traffic restrictions will be in place on the course, with the start at 9:00 AM, registration until November 6th, and the event held at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Center as well as on Sielska, Schumana, and Kapitańska streets.

name: Gdyński Bieg Niepodległości
description: The Gdynia Independence Run is an annual running event organized in Gdynia, as part of the Gdynia Grand Prix 2026. The main race on a 10 km distance attracts runners of various ages, and there are also children's and youth races. The event has a sports-recreational character, and participants can expect professional organization and an atmosphere celebrating Polish independence. During the event, photos and video materials are taken for promotional purposes by the organizers.
course_highlights: Main race on a 10 km distance
Children's and youth races
Part of the Gdynia Grand Prix 2026
additional: During the event, photos and video materials will be taken for promotional purposes of events organized by GCS and the Gdynia City Municipality. Registration is open until October 28, 2026. Results, photo galleries, and partner information are available.

name: II Bieg Legionów Polskich
description: The Polish Legion Run II is a race commemorating the anniversary of Poland regaining independence, held on two distances: 5 km and 10 km. Starts take place in scenic seaside locations: Władysławowo, Rozewie, and Jastrzębia Góra. The organizer provides transportation from Jastrzębia Góra to the start locations and opens the race office the day before and on the race day. The race route is available online, allowing participants to familiarize themselves with the course before the start.
course_highlights: The race route passes through Władysławowo, Rozewie, and Jastrzębia Góra
10 km start from the Haller monument at Morska Street in Władysławowo
5 km start from the bust of Marshal Piłsudski at Garnizonowa Street in Rozewie
additional: Transportation from Jastrzębia Góra to the start locations is provided. The race office is open on November 10, 2025, from 14:30 to 15:30 at OSiR Władysławowo and on November 11, 2025, from 10:20 to 10:50 in Jastrzębia Góra. The race route is available online at https://www.traseo.pl/trasa/bieg-legionow-polskich. Registration is open from September 22 to November 5, 2025; the event takes place on moderately elevated routes, starting in Władysławowo and Rozewie.

name: XIV Bieg Niepodległości
description: The 14th Independence Run is an annual street race covering a distance of 10 km, organized in Rzeszów to promote an active lifestyle and running in the Podkarpacie region. The start and finish are located at the Rzeszów Market Square, and the race takes place on November 11th, on Poland's Independence Day. Participants compete in various age categories and special classifications, including for doctors and lawyers. Participants receive a race kit with a T-shirt, number, and chip, and a commemorative medal at the finish line. The participant limit is 3000 people, and participation requires confirmation of fitness to run through a medical certificate or declaration.
course_highlights: Street race over 10 km with start and finish at the Market Square in Rzeszów
Separate age and special classifications (e.g., doctors, lawyers)
Commemorative medal for every participant at the finish

The race kit includes a T-shirt, race number, and chip. Custom engraving on the medal is available for an additional fee of 30 PLN. The registration fee is non-refundable. The race takes place in Rytro, and the event is part of the celebrations of National Independence Day.

description: The Grand Prix of Kościan County is a series of five 5 km races organized by all municipalities of Kościan County under the patronage of the Starosta of Kościan. The aim is to promote physical activity, healthy competition, and integration of local residents. Participants must be residents of the county and at least 16 years old in 2025. Each race is paid separately, and the overall classification is based on the total points earned in each race.

Separate classification for women and men, without age category divisions

The point classification sums results from each race, with prizes for the top 6 women and top 6 men, as well as additional special prizes from the organizers of each race. The series includes five 5 km races held from June to December, with classification and prizes for the best. The main 10 km race is scheduled for November 15, 2026, in Kościerzyna, with typical autumn weather, possible rain.

Team classification and trophies for the best

The race traditionally starts on the clearing behind the Piast stadium, and participants can expect a friendly atmosphere and an active way to end February. The event is an excellent opportunity to start the new month with energy and good spirits.

The event offers various competition formats, including timed runs and Nordic Walking marches, tailored to different skill levels. Start and finish at the Winter Sports Center in Ptaszkowa

The race office is open on race day from 06:45 to 07:30 for the 6/12/24-hour distances and until 9:30 for Nordic Walking and single lap runs. The points are located in the terrain and marked on the map. The event is open to participants of all ages and skill levels, including enthusiasts and recreational participants, such as families. Rogaining has a tourist-sport character and allows for flexible route modifications during the competition, making it an attractive outdoor activity. The event is organized by the Polish Tourist and Sightseeing Society, Strzelin Branch, which has been hosting orienteering competitions in the region for years.

Control points have different point values depending on the difficulty of finding them
Participants can choose and change their route freely, from 5 to 70 km in length
additional: The competition is open to all age groups and genders. Teams consist of 2-5 people. Rogaining is a tourist-sport activity suitable for both advanced competitors and families. Routes can be modified during the event. In 2026, four editions of rogaining are planned around Strzelin, including the 45th edition in November. The events cover various distances from 5 km to 70 km, with maps and compasses, catering to different skill levels, with options for recreational and competitive participation.

name: Szybka Piątka
description: Szybka Piątka is a 5 km race organized in Lublin, taking place on November 29, 2026. The event is part of a series of races organized by the Sports Development Foundation in Lublin, promoting physical activity and social integration. It is an excellent opportunity to end the season in an atmosphere of sporting competition and contact with nature. The event is part of a nationwide mountain running series that promotes physical activity and respect for the environment.

Varied terrain with dense forests, valleys, gorges, and ravines
Challenging elevation changes and natural ascents characteristic of trail running

Running community and integration of the local community

GPX files for the half marathon, marathon, and 6 km and 12 km runs are available. The routes lead through forest paths with numerous steep ascents and breathtaking views, offering challenges for runners of various skill levels. Myślenice is a place that combines natural beauty, history, and modern infrastructure, making the event an attractive activity for active recreation enthusiasts. The Garmin Ultra Race series promotes running in harmony with nature, fair play, and supporting the running community.

description: The Hero Run is a unique running event held in Klucze near Olkusz, offering various distances and competition formats on challenging, sandy terrain. Shorter distances are also available, such as Nomad 3h, dynamic 5- and 7-kilometer loops, as well as races for children and special dog runs that highlight cooperation and trust between the handler and the dog. The event also features joint activities coordinated by therapists and volunteers, which further promotes integration.

Joint activities coordinated by therapists and volunteers
additional: The number of spots is limited to 300 participants. Start packages can be collected at the Race Office on Friday, May 16, from 10:00 to 12:00 and 14:00 to 16:00, as well as on the day of the event from 12:00 to 13:00. Starts are divided into age categories with different distances from 200 to 600 meters. The Race Office and start are located at the Szyszka restaurant. The race is inclusive, with routes for children and adults, taking place on an asphalt trail in Arkonka, with online registration available until May 10, 2025. The race is scheduled to start at 13:00.

name: III M Park4RUN
description: The III M Park4RUN Half Marathon is a race approximately 21.2 km long, scheduled to take place on May 9, 2026, in Tarnów, at the M Park Shopping Center. The race route is 100% asphalt, flat, and marked every 1 km, with limited road traffic during the event. The event promotes popularization of running and recreation as well as integration of the local community. In addition to the main race, there are also races for children and youth on various distances suitable for their age. Participants of the main race receive a starter pack containing items from sponsors as well as informational and promotional materials.

Refreshment points at 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and finish

The office for children opens at 10:00, with children's and youth races around 12:00-12:30, and awards ceremony approximately 12:30-13:00. Right-hand traffic is enforced on the route. Classifications include OPEN women and men as well as age categories for adults and children. Approximate distances for children: 100 m (preschoolers), 250 m (grades I-III), 500 m (grades IV-VI), 800 m (grades VII-VIII). Registration for the event was available online. The event also includes races for children and community activities.

The atmosphere is friendly and family-oriented, as confirmed by positive feedback from previous participants.

additional: Program of the day: 10:40 official start, 10:50 warm-up, 10:55 lining up at the start, 11:00 race start, 11:50 children's races, 12:15 award ceremony, 12:45 official end. The route starts in the town center. After the race, prizes and a friendly atmosphere with refreshments are provided. The participant limit is 200. The race is part of the Grand Prix of Chełmno Land. Online registration, timing measurement, and live results are available.

The race is of moderate difficulty and takes place on an asphalt urban route. Organizers provide expert support and detailed training instructions to help everyone prepare optimally for the start.

description: Beskidy Short Race is a European adventure race held in the picturesque Beskid Mountains, on the border between Poland and Slovakia. The competition includes various disciplines such as MTB, trekking, kayaking, climbing, and orienteering, with routes leading through mountainous areas offering beautiful views and challenging sections. The event is designed for teams of two or individual participants, providing an intense challenge for adventure and outdoor sports enthusiasts. The start and finish are located in the Koszyce area, and organizers provide professional support and assistance.
course_highlights: Approximately 200 km route with MTB, trekking, and kayaking
Traversing the Beskid Mountains and Orawa region
Varied mountain terrain with orienteering and climbing elements
additional: The race lasts about 30 hours plus an additional 2 hours. Teams can be mixed 4-person or 2-person of any gender. The race office and start/finish: Dworek nad Wisłą, Wyzwolenia 65, 43-460 Wisła, Poland. The race includes disciplines such as climbing, kayaking, navigation, and field tasks, with routes passing through scenic areas of Polish mountains, including caves and rock formations.

name: VIII Ultramaraton Warmiński Warneland
description: The 8th Warmia Ultramarathon Warneland is a unique running event held in the picturesque Olsztyn. The route takes runners through charming Warmia trails, along the Łyna River and Ukiel Lake, offering contact with nature and beautiful views. The event is a great opportunity for active recreation, suitable for both experienced ultramarathon runners and younger running enthusiasts, who can participate in the children's races Ultra Warmiaczek. The atmosphere of the competition fosters integration and shared sporting adventure.
course_highlights: Picturesque Warmia trails around Olsztyn
Route along the Łyna River and Ukiel Lake
Contact with nature and charming views
additional: Packet pickup takes place on May 9, 2026, from 17:00 to 21:00 at the Best Western Plus Olsztyn Old Town Hotel and from 07:30 to 10:00 at CRS Ukiel for children's races. The start times for the W50+ and W25+ distances are at 08:00. The time limit for completing the W50+ race is 10 hours, and for W25+ it is 5 hours. After this time, participants must leave the course and remove their bib numbers. The Ultra Warmiaczek children's races start at 11:10. The race village is located at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Center, near numerous hotels and apartments. The event includes distances of 53 km, 32 km, 19 km, and children's races, with time limits of 10 and 5 hours, and the start and finish are at CRS Ukiel in Olsztyn. Participants can expect medical and logistical support. Registration closes on April 26, 2025.
